docs.title: 5. 功能规范
docs.text: 原文标题：Functional specification

docs.title: 6. 简介
docs.text:
原文标题：Introduction

The Secure Hardware Extension (SHE) is an on-chip extension to any given microcontroller. It is intended to move the control over cryptographic keys from the software domain into the hardware domain and therefore protect those keys from software attacks. However, it is not meant to replace highly secure solutions like TPM chips or smart cards, i.e. no tamper resistance is required by the specification.

The main goals for the design at hand are

  • Protect cryptographic keys from software attacks
  • Provide an authentic software environment
  • Let the security only depend on the strength of the underlying algorithm and the confidentiality of the keys
  • Allow for distributed key ownerships
  • Keep the flexibility high and the costs low

Basically SHE consists of three building blocks, a storage area to keep the cryptographic keys and additional corresponding information, a implementation of a block cipher (AES) and a control logic connecting the parts to the CPU of the microcontroller, see for a simplified block diagram. SHE can be implemented in several ways, e.g. a finite state machine or a small, dedicated CPU core.

……本章内容较长已节选，完整内容见「本地文件」中的纯文本全文。

docs.title: 7. Conventions
docs.text:
In the following chapters several paragraphs are printed italic. These paragraphs are not meant as a hard requirement but to provide additional explanation of the underlying mechanisms.

Throughout the whole document the term "CPU" denotes the actual microprocessor while "microcontroller" is used to describe the hardware complete chip, i.e. a CPU and all included peripherals. The term "control logic" refers to the system (e.g. a finite state machine or a small microprocessor) controlling the algorithms and memories inside of SHE.

Cryptographic operations are written as

OUTPUT = OPERATION_{\texttt{MODE,KEY[,IV]}} (INPUT [, INPUT2, ...])

Additionally the following symbols are used to describe the operations:

\oplus bitwise exclusive or concatenation of two values

Whenever interfaces to the CPU are described the internal memory slots of SHE, which are not exposed to the CPU, are identified by their address. An actual key is generally written as KEY_{\texttt{KEY_NAME}} while the identifier of the key is written as ID_{\texttt{KEY_NAME}}.

All values are given in the form MSB...LSB, i.e. the most significant bit/byte is on the left.

Bit sequences given in the form

……本章内容较长已节选，完整内容见「本地文件」中的纯文本全文。

docs.title: 8. 基础需求
docs.text:
原文标题：Basic Requirements

SHE has to be realized as an on-chip peripheral of the microcontroller. SHE must not have any other connections except those explicitly specified within this document. If additional resources have to be included to assure proper function during the fabrication of the chip, all ports have to be physically and permanently deactivated if accessible on external pins.

SHE can be connected to the CPU in several ways, e.g. through a dedicated interface or an internal peripheral bus. The interconnection must be implemented in a way that no other peripheral or an external entity can modify the data transferred between the CPU and SHE.

SHE does not need to be fabricated in a special process to increase security nor need any actions to be taken to strengthen the system against physical attacks, e.g. etching the chip casing open, differential power analysis, glitching attacks.

Note: No sophisticated secure hardware mechanisms are required to meet the specification of SHE. However, a manufacturer may of course strengthen the design to provide a higher security level for higher security requirements.

……本章内容较长已节选，完整内容见「本地文件」中的纯文本全文。

docs.title: 9. Algorithms
docs.text:
All cryptographic operations of SHE are processed by an AES-128 . The latency of the AES must remain <2us per encryption/decryption of a single block, including the key schedule.

Additionally, the performance of the AES must be high enough to allow for a secure boot (see Chapter for details) of 5% of the flash memory, but 32kByte at minimum and 128kByte at maximum, of the microcontroller in <10ms.

In case the flash memory is slower than requested, the flash memory must be the limiting factor for the secure boot and the limit has to be stated in the datasheet.

docs.title: 10. Encryption/decryption
docs.text:
For encryption and decryption of data, SHE has to support the electronic cipher book mode (ECB) for processing single blocks of data and the cipher block chaining mode (CBC) for processing larger amounts of data, see for details.

The latency for both modes may not exceed the value given in the beginning of

SHE can only process multiples of the block length of the AES, i.e. all necessary padding has to be done by an application.

The input, output and key input as well as any intermediate results may not be directly accessible by the CPU but access must be granted depending on the policies by the controller logic of SHE.

docs.title: 11. MAC generation/verification
docs.text: The MAC generation and verification has to be implemented as a CMAC using the AES-128 as specified by . See for updated examples.

docs.title: 12. Compression 功能
docs.text:
原文标题：Compression function

The Miyaguchi-Preneel construction (see Algorithm 9.43) with the AES as block cipher is used as compression function within SHE. Messages have to be preprocessed before feeding them to the compression algorithm, i.e. they have to be padded and parsed into 128 bit chunks.

Padding is done by appending one '1' bit to the message M of bit-length l, followed by k '0' bits, where k is the smallest, non-negative solution to the equation l + 1 + k \equiv 88 \textrm{mod} 128. Finally append a 40 bit block that is equal to the number l expressed using an unsigned binary representation.

Before feeding the padded message to the compression function, it has to be parsed into n 128 bit chunks x_1, x_2, ..., x_n. The value \textrm{OUT}_0 is called initialization vector (IV).

\texttt{AES-MP}(x_i): \textrm{OUT}i = \textrm{ENC}{i-1}}(x_i) \oplus x_i \oplus \textrm{OUT}_0 = 0;}; i>0; \textrm{OUT

docs.title: 13. Key derivations
docs.text:
Keys are derived using the Miyaguchi-Preneel compression algorithm based on . Derived keys are calculated by compressing the correctly preprocessed concatenation of a secret K and a constant C' with

C' = 0x01 counter "SHE" 0x00

Note that the constants C given in have already been padded according to .

KDF(K, C): AES-MP(K C)

docs.title: 14. 数据 storage
docs.text:
原文标题：Data storage

SHE needs memory to store keys and MACs. A non-volatile memory is required to store information that needs to be available after power cycles and resets of the microcontroller. A volatile memory is required to store temporary information. The volatile memory may loose its contents on reset or power cycles.

The memory of SHE should only be accessible by the SHE control logic. The CPU or any other peripherals, including debugging and testing facilities being available without opening the chip package, should not be able to access the memory.

If data from and to the non-volatile memory of SHE has to be transferred over a bus shared with other peripherals and it could not be guaranteed that these data will not be read or modified by any other instance, the following precautions have to be taken transparently to all functionality of SHE:

  • An additional, individual key has to be stored inside of SHE.

……本章内容较长已节选，完整内容见「本地文件」中的纯文本全文。

docs.title: 15. Security flags for 存储 slots
docs.text:
原文标题：Security flags for memory slots

When flags are transmitted in protocols the value "0" shall mean the flag is not set and "1" shall mean the flag is set. See for details which key is protected by which security bits.

docs.title: 16. Write-protection of 存储 slots
docs.text:
原文标题：Write-protection of memory slots

Non-volatile keys, see Chapter , can be write-protected, i.e. it is not possible to change the key anymore, even if the corresponding secret is known.

The write-protection must be irreversible.

The write-protection is stored in a non-volatile memory only accessible by SHE and evaluated by the state machine controlling SHE upon write access.

Whenever the flag is transmitted in a protocol and it is not applicable to that particular key, it has to be transmitted as "0" and ignored by SHE.

The flag must not be set for any key after production.

docs.title: 17. Disabling keys on boot failure
docs.text:
Non-volatile keys, see Chapter , can be disabled separately when the secure boot mechanism (see Chapter ) detects a manipulation of the software or the secure boot process is bypassed by other boot mechanisms, e.g., by boot strapping over external interfaces. The memory slots may only be reactivated on next successful boot.

Disabling a key shall mean that SHE refuses to use the memory slot in any operation except those explicitly stated.

The status of this protection is stored in a non-volatile memory area only accessible by SHE and evaluated by the state machine controlling SHE upon read and write access.

Whenever the flag is transmitted in a protocol and it is not applicable to that particular key, it has to be transmitted as "0" and ignored by SHE.

The flag must not be set for any key after production.

docs.title: 18. Disabling keys on debugger activation
docs.text:
Non-volatile keys, see Chapter , can be disabled separately when a debugger is attached (e.g., JTAG, BDM) or any other mechanism is activated to boot without measuring the boot process by SHE while secure booting is activated, e.g. bootstrap over external interfaces. The memory slots may only be reactivated after a reset.

Disabling a key shall mean that SHE refuses to use the memory slot in any operation except those explicitly stated.

The status of the debugging protection is stored in a non-volatile memory area only accessible by SHE and evaluated by the state machine controlling SHE upon read and write access.

Whenever the flag is transmitted in a protocol and it is not applicable to that particular key, it has to be transmitted as "0" and ignored by SHE.

The flag must not be set for any key after production.

docs.title: 19. Disable wildcard usage for key updates
docs.text:
The flag determines if a key may be updated without supplying a valid UID, i.e. by supplying a special wildcard. For details on updating keys see Chapter for details on the UID see Chapter .

If the flag is set, wildcards are not allowed.

The flag must not be set for any key after production.

docs.title: 20. Key usage determination
docs.text:
The flag determines if a key can be used for encryption/decryption or for MAC generation/verification.

If the flag is set, the key is used for MAC generation/verification.

The flag has only to be implemented for the keys KEY_, see Chapter .

Whenever the flag is transmitted in a protocol and it is not applicable to that particular key, it has to be transmitted as "0" and ignored by SHE.

docs.title: 21. Plain key flag
docs.text: The flag has only to be implemented for RAM_KEY, see Chapter . The flag has to be set by SHE whenever a key is loaded into KEY_{RAM_KEY} in plaintext. The flag is evaluated before exporting a RAM_KEY. The flag has to be reset whenever a key is loaded by the secure protocol, see Chapter .

docs.title: 22. Non-volatile 存储 slots
docs.text:
原文标题：Non-volatile memory slots

The keys and the corresponding policies are described in detail within the following sections.

Non-volatile memory slots must implement a mechanism to detect empty memory slots, i.e. memory slots that have not been populated with a key after erasing or after production. Empty memory slots may not be used by any function but for inserting a key via the key update protocol described in Chapter .

docs.title: 23. MASTER_ECU_KEY
docs.text:
Note: The MASTER_ECU_KEY is intended to be populated by the "owner" of the component using SHE and it can be used to reset SHE or change any of the other keys.

The MASTER_ECU_KEY is only used for updating other memory slots inside of SHE, see Chapter for details on updating memory slots.

A new MASTER_ECU_KEY can be written with the knowledge of the current MASTER_ECU_KEY and is protected by the common lock mechanisms described in Chapter , Chapter , Chapter and Chapter .

The MASTER_ECU_KEY must be empty after production.

docs.title: 24. BOOT_MAC_KEY
docs.text:
The BOOT_MAC_KEY is used by the secure booting mechanism to verify the authenticity of the software.

The BOOT_MAC_KEY may also be used to verify a MAC.

See Chapter for details on the secure booting.

The BOOT_MAC_KEY can be written with the knowledge of the MASTER_ECU_KEY or BOOT_MAC_KEY and is protected by the common lock mechanisms described in Chapter , Chapter , Chapter and Chapter .

Note: When changing the BOOT_MAC_KEY the BOOT_MAC usually should be changed, too, except when first activating secure booting for autonomous MAC learning, see Chapter .

The BOOT_MAC_KEY must be empty after production.

docs.title: 25. BOOT_MAC
docs.text:
Note: The BOOT_MAC is required for the secure boot mechanism and is therefore stored inside of SHE. It is not considered to be a secret information, however, it is treated like any other key inside of SHE for the ease of use.

The BOOT_MAC is used to store the MAC of the Bootloader of the secure booting mechanism and may only be accessible to the booting mechanism of SHE.

See Chapter for details on the secure booting.

The BOOT_MAC can be written with the knowledge of the MASTER_ECU_KEY or BOOT_MAC_KEY and is protected by the common lock mechanisms described in Chapter , Chapter , Chapter and Chapter .

The BOOT_MAC must be empty after production.

docs.title:
26. KEY_

Note: The KEY_ are actually intended to be used to process bulk data in any given application.

KEY_ can be used for arbitrary functions. n is a number 3..10, i.e. SHE must at least implement three and at maximum ten keys for arbitrary use.

The usage of the keys has to be selected between encryption/decryption or MAC generation/verification on programming time by setting the key usage flag accordingly, see Chapter .

KEY_ can be written with the knowledge of the MASTER_ECU_KEY or the current KEY_ and is protected by the common lock mechanisms described in Chapter , Chapter , Chapter and Chapter .

The KEY_ must be empty after production.

27. PRNG_SEED

PRNG_SEED is used to store the seed for pseudo random number generator as described in Chapter . If the random number generator is implemented as described in Chapter the memory slot is not required.

PRNG_SEED may only be accessed by CMD_INIT_RNG as described in Chapter .

PRNG_SEED must be initialized during fabrication of the chip. Its value must be generated by a certified physical random number generator, e.g. a High Security Module (HSM), and should meet at least the requirements of class P2 from .

Note: PRNG_SEED needs to be recalculated (see Chapter ) before random numbers can be requested, i.e. in worst-case scenarios it is written on every power cycle/reset.

28. Volatile 存储 slots

原文标题：Volatile memory slots

The volatile memory slots should be cleared to "0" on reset or power-on-cycles.

The volatile memory slots are not protected by the lock mechanisms specified in Chapter , Chapter and Chapter

29. RAM_KEY

The RAM_KEY can be used for arbitrary operations.

The RAM_KEY can be written with the knowledge of the KEY_ or in plain text.

The RAM_KEY can be exported if it was loaded as plaintext, see CMD_EXPORT_RAM_KEY in Chapter . A key loaded by the secure protocol may not be exported. The origin of the key has to be stored in a flag, see Chapter .

Note: Since the keys loaded into RAM_KEY are stored externally they are not under full control of SHE, hence they are vulnerable to several attacks, e.g. replay attacks and denial of service attacks. It is strongly advised to consider this fact when designing applications.

30. PRNG_KEY

The PRNG_KEY is not directly accessible by any user function but is used by the pseudo random number generator. See Chapter for details on usage and data population.

The PRNG_KEY may also be implemented in non-volatile memory. In this case the key has to be generated, populated and protected by the same means as SECRET_KEY (see Chapter ).

31. PRNG_STATE

This memory slot holds the state of the pseudo random number generator.

The PRNG_STATE is not directly accessible by any user function but is used by the pseudo random number generator. See Chapter for details on usage and data population.

32. Read-Only 存储 slots

原文标题：Read-Only memory slots

Two memory slots are defined read-only during the life-cycle of the controller. Read-only shall mean that they are at least protected by the controller logic, i.e. they may be writable during production but not after leaving the fabrication.

33. SECRET_KEY

SHE must contain a unique secret key SECRET_KEY that shall not only be derived from the serial number or any other publicly available information.

The SECRET_KEY has to be inserted during chip fabrication by the semiconductor manufacturer and should not be stored outside of SHE.

The SECRET_KEY must at least meet the requirements of class P2 from . It can be generated by a certified physical random number generator, e.g. a Hardware Security Module (HSM).

The SECRET_KEY may only be used to import/export keys.

34. Unique identification item UID

SHE or the microcontroller must contain a unique identification item, i.e. a serial number, of at most 120 bits. The identification item must be directly accessible by the controller logic of SHE.

Note: The UID is specified to 120 bit because it is always used in conjunction with two key ids or the status register to form a 128 bit block.

If the identification item is smaller than 120 bits it has to be padded with zero bits on the MSB side before feeding it into SHE.

The UID has to be inserted during chip fabrication by the semiconductor manufacturer.

The UID may not be 0, i.e. at least one bit has to be set. The UID with the value 0 is reserved as a wildcard UID for updating keys.

Note: The UID does not have to follow a special format, i.e. already inserted serial numbers can be reused. It should at least be unique for all chips of a certain manufacturer.

The UID may be exported through additional ports from SHE to be used with other components on the microcontroller. It must not be possible to affect the operation or status of SHE through this port.

35. Identification of 存储 slots

原文标题：Identification of memory slots

All memory slots being accessible by user-functions must be addressable by a four-bit value. The internal, physical addressing may differ. shows the address of every key.

Key name Address (hexadecimal) Memory area SECRET_KEY 0x0 ROM MASTER_ECU_KEY 0x1 non-volatile BOOT_MAC_KEY 0x2 ^ BOOT_MAC 0x3 ^ KEY_1 0x4 ^ KEY_2 0x5 ^ KEY_3 0x6 ^ KEY_4 0x7 ^ KEY_5 0x8 ^ KEY_6 0x9 ^ KEY_7 0xa ^ KEY_8 0xb ^ KEY_9 0xc ^ KEY_10 0xd ^ RAM_KEY 0xe volatile

36. Random number generation

SHE must include pseudo random number generator. The seed can be generated in two ways as described in Chapter

Note: Only one of the two described methods has to be implemented

The random numbers may not be generated directly by a true random number generator.

Note: A "P1 medium" true random number generator (TRNG) may not be directly used for the purposes of SHE due to cryptographic reasons. Even smart cards or other advanced security solutions which possess high-quality physical sources of randomness usually rely at least on a compression of the TRNG output.

Note: The pseudo random number generator is designed to provide random numbers at constant quality for generating challenges for authentication at rates only limited by the performance of the underlying algorithm (AES).

37. Seed generation

The seed for the pseudo random number generator can be generated in two different ways. Either by implementing another pseudo random number generator as described in Chapter or by compressing the output of a true random number generator as described in Chapter .

38. Seed generation through a pseudo random number generator (PRNG)

The seed is a non-volatile 128 bit value used as the input to the random number generator.

The seed is updated by invoking the command CMD_INIT_RNG, see Chapter

To update the seed, a key is derived with PRNG_SEED_KEY_C from SECRET_KEY (see Chapter for the values of the single constants). The derived key is used to encrypt PRNG_SEED. The output has to be stored to PRNG_SEED first and must only be transferred to PRNG_STATE after completing the write transaction to PRNG_SEED.

PRNG_SEED_KEY = KDF(SECRET_KEY, PRNG_SEED_KEY_C) PRNG_SEED_(}} = ENC_{\texttt{ECB,PRNG_SEED_KEY}PRNG_SEED_)}

If PRNG_KEY is implemented as a volatile memory slot, a key for running the PRNG has to be derived from SECRET_KEY and PRNG_KEY_C (see Chapter for the values of the single constants).

PRNG_KEY = KDF(SECRET_KEY, PRNG_KEY_C)

39. Seed generation trough a true random number generator (TRNG)

The TRNG must at least fulfill the requirement "P1 medium" as described in in all operating conditions according to the rating of the chip.

The seed is a 128 bit value used as the input to the random number generator. After generation it has to be stored as PRNG_STATE.

The seed is generated by invoking the command CMD_INIT_RNG, see Chapter .

The entropy of the seed needs to be at least 80 bits, i.e. if the level of entropy delivered by the TRNG is lower, enough entropy has to be collected and compressed. The semiconductor manufacturer has to provide evidence of reaching this entropy level upon request or in the data sheet.

The compression function has to be called at least once to generate the seed.

To compress the output of the TRNG into the seed the Miyaguchi-Preneel compression function can be used as defined in Chapter

If PRNG_KEY (see Chapter ) is implemented as a volatile memory slot, a key for running the PRNG has to be derived according to Chapter .

40. Random generation

The random number generator must not output any random values before the seed is updated as described above.

To generate a new random value according to E.4 , the content of PRNG_STATE is encrypted with PRNG_KEY. The output of the encryption is used as the input for the next random generation (encryption), i.e. it replaces PRNG_STATE, and is also output to the user, see for details on the workflow:

PRNG_STATE_(}} = ENC_{\texttt{ECB,PRNG_KEY}PRNG_STATE_) RND = }PRNG_STATE_}

That is, the implementation of PRNG must fulfill K3 with strength of mechanisms "high" according to .

41. Extending the seed

The seed and the current PRNG_STATE can be extended by any user by calling the function CMD_EXTEND_SEED and supplying 128 bit of entropy. The seed and the state are extended by compressing the concatenation of the old seed/state and the entropy input with the Miyaguchi-Preneel compression function described above. The input to the compression function has to be preprocessed according to Chapter . Since the compression is a fixed length operation for 2x128 bit = 256 bit the padding becomes a constant operation. The padding is given as constant PRNG_EXTENSION_C in Chapter .

PRNG_STATE = AES-MP(PRNG_STATE \mid ENTROPY) PRNG_SEED = AES-MP(PRNG_SEED \mid ENTROPY)

42. Status Register

A status register can be read by the CPU to check the internal state of SHE. The status register has a total width of 8 bits. If a bit is set its value is '1', if it is cleared its value is '0'.

Bit Name Description 2^0 BUSY The bit is set whenever SHE is processing a command. 2^1 SECURE_BOOT The bit is set if the secure booting is activated. 2^2 BOOT_INIT The bit is set if the secure booting has been personalized during the boot sequence. 2^3 BOOT_FINISHED The bit is set when the secure booting has been finished by calling either CMD_BOOT_FAILURE or CMD_BOOT_OK or if CMD_SECURE_BOOT failed in verifying BOOT_MAC. 2^4 BOOT_OK The bit is set if the secure booting (CMD_SECURE_BOOT) succeeded. If CMD_BOOT_FAILURE is called the bit is erased. 2^5 RND_INIT The bit is set if the random number generator has been initialized. 2^6 EXT_DEBUGGER The bit is set if an external debugger is connected to the chip, i.e. it reflects the input for debugger activation. 2^7 INT_DEBUGGER The bit is set if the internal debugging mechanisms of SHE are activated

43. User-accessible Functions

SHE provides several functions to the CPU. In general, only a single function can be executed at a given time. Only the commands CMD_GET_STATUS (Chapter ) and CMD_CANCEL (Chapter ) may be called while another function is processed.

In the following subchapters all available functions are listed together with the necessary parameters, the direction of the parameters and the width of the single parameters in bits.

The function interface has to be asynchronous, i.e. all functions have to be non-blocking for the CPU and therefore return immediately.

Despite of returning data, every function must be able to return an error code to communicate the status of the processing to the calling application, see Chapter for details on error codes.

If a function returns an error code the output data has to be set to '0'.

Note: If output has been generated and transmitted, e.g., on CBC operations or via DMA transfer, this output does not have to be deleted but the output of the round containing an error has to be '0'. Especially the CMAC functions may not output anything on errors.

docs.title: 文档简介
docs.text: This technical report provides the Security Event (SEv) specification of the AUTOSAR Standard.

docs.title: 1. 简介
docs.text:
原文标题：Introduction

This technical report provides the Security Event (SEv) specification of the AUTOSAR Standard.

docs.title: 2. 目标
docs.text:
原文标题：Objectives

Efficient intrusion detection is heavily relying on IDS sensors monitoring sensible resources and providing high-quality information to the Vehicle Security Operation Center (VSOC). AUTOSAR implements a set of IDS sensors as part of the AUTOSAR software specification, where the respective SEv specification can be found in the corresponding SWS documents. This document collects these AUTOSAR-specified SEvs and provides an overview on all SEvs that are defined in AUTOSAR, including their specification.

The SEv specification in this document is provided in the form of generated tables. The source of the generated tables is the document FO_MOD_GeneralDefinitions , which can be used as a machine-readable version of the SEv specification in the VSOC.

Please note that this document does not contain the trigger condition under which the SEv is raised by the AUTOSAR stack. The trigger condition can be found in the SWS document of the module that raises the respective SEv.

docs.title: 3. 文档结构
docs.text:
原文标题：Document structure

This document is structured as follows:

  • Chapter 4 contains a list of all SEvs defined by AUTOSAR in a tabular form. The list contains SEv ID, Name, Description and AUTOSAR module that raises the SEv, but no context data.
  • Chapter 5 contains detailed SEv specification including the SEvs context data. The chapter contains only SEvs for which context data is specified.

docs.title: 文档简介
docs.text:
This document represents recommended methods and practices for timing analysis and design within the AUTOSAR development process. It is intended for different kinds of readers:

  • System, development and test engineers with no or little knowledge of timing analysis
  • Engineers with general knowledge of timing analysis who want to enhance their understanding of AUTOSAR methodology
  • Further stakeholders (listed under )

docs.title: 1. 简介
docs.text:
原文标题：Introduction

This document represents recommended methods and practices for timing analysis and design within the AUTOSAR development process. It is intended for different kinds of readers:

  • System, development and test engineers with no or little knowledge of timing analysis
  • Engineers with general knowledge of timing analysis who want to enhance their understanding of AUTOSAR methodology
  • Further stakeholders (listed under )

docs.title: 2. Objective
docs.text: During the development of AUTOSAR based systems, a common technical approach for timing analysis is needed to fulfill the AUTOSAR main requirement RS_Main_00340. This document describes all major steps of timing analysis needed from the definition and validation of functional timing requirements to the verification of timing requirements on component and system level. Figure illustrates the different aspects for timing analysis. Basis for the described methods are AUTOSAR Methodology and AUTOSAR timing extensions .

docs.title: 3. 概述
docs.text:
原文标题：Overview

The AUTOSAR timing analysis methodology is divided in following parts:

  • Decomposition of timing requirements
  • Timing analysis on function level
  • End-to-end timing analysis for distributed functions
  • Timing analysis on the network level
  • Timing analysis on the ECU level
  • Timing properties and methods for timing analysis

For each part, a proposed methodology is presented based using a number of typical real world use-cases. A complete overview of all use-cases is given in section on page .

docs.title: 4. Motivation
docs.text:
The increasing number of functions, complexity in E/E Architectures and the resulting requirements on ECUs and communication networks imply increasing requirements on the development process. A central part of the development process is the design of robust and extendible ECUs and network architectures.

In the development of ECUs complexity is introduced through the integration of multiple SW-Cs (constituting various functions) executed in schedulable tasks. The design and verification of the task schedules becomes difficult due to their dependencies on shared resources such as processing cores and memory.

On the network level heterogeneous network types such as CAN, LIN, FlexRay, MOST and Ethernet are used. This makes it hard to ensure robustness, especially when routing between protocols over a gateway takes place. The design of an efficient and robust network architecture and configuration is increasingly difficult. This creates the need for a systematic approach.

These aspects must be addressed in the E/E development process together with additional requirements regarding quality, testability, ability to perform diagnostic services and so on.

……本章内容较长已节选，完整内容见「本地文件」中的纯文本全文。

docs.title: 5. 示例
docs.text:
原文标题：Example

The active steering shown in the figure demonstrates an end-to-end timing constraint with a real-world AUTOSAR Classic Platform (CP) example. The system consists of sensors, ECUs, buses and an actuator. With the vehicle dynamics model of the car and the active steering function the functional developer defined a maximum reaction time for the outlined chain: 30ms. This becomes a top level end-to-end timing requirement for the system.

This timing requirement then gets decomposed, i.e. it gets sliced into smaller portions T1...T5, one portion for each component of the system. Obviously, ECUs and buses handle many different features with their own timing requirements, all competing for network and computation resources. On an ECU with tasks/interrupts and their Runnable Entities, the top level timing requirements are broken down into more fine grained timing requirements and the competition for resources is continued on a lower level.

In this example, the embedded software is developed independently from the later allocation on concrete ECUs, i.e. ICM and ASA in Figure .

docs.title: 6. 范围
docs.text:
原文标题：Scope

This document describes how to implement timing analysis during the development of E/E systems. Similar to , this does not include a complete process description but rather a set of practical methods to define timing requirements and how to ensure that these requirements are met. As stated in , the methodology is designed to cover the needs of various AUTOSAR stakeholders:

  • Organizations: Methodology is modeled in a modular format to allow organizations to tailor it and combine the methodology within their own internal processes, while identifying points where they interact with other organizations.
  • Engineers: Methodology is scoped to allow engineers of various roles quickly find AUTOSAR information that is relevant to their specific needs.
  • Tool Vendors: Methodology provides a common language to share among all AUTOSAR members and a common expectation of what capabilities tools should support.

The following topics are addressed:

  • Definition of appropriate timing analysis methods including related timing properties for all stages of an AUTOSAR development process without disclosure of company confidential information.

docs.title: 8. 术语表 of Terms
docs.text:
原文标题：Glossary of Terms

Term Synonym Definition Event-triggered Frame Sporadic Frame A frame that is sent on an event triggered by the application independent from a communication schedule. The event-triggered sending is limited by a debounce time which specifies the shortest allowed temporal distance between two occurrences. Accuracy The accuracy is the closeness to the true value. For the worst case of a timing property it describes the maximum overestimation. Cause-Effect Chain A cause-effect chain represents the data-flow among communicating components, by relating read events of a consumer component to the corresponding write events of a producer component. Execution Time The execution time is the total time that the function needs to be assigned the resource in order to complete. Event Chain An event chain describes a causal order for a set of functionally dependent timing events. (See TimingDescriptionEventChain in ) Frame Message A frame is a data package sent over a communication medium. This element describes the structure of data (OSI layer 2) sent on a channel. For example, a frame on CAN and FlexRay. A commonly used synonym is "message".

docs.title: 9. 限制
docs.text:
原文标题：Limitations

One of the key features of the AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform is adaptability. Applications can be started and stopped on-the-fly. Existing applications updated or even new applications installed over-the-air. This results in the possibility of operation conditions changing rapidly and unpredictably. It is no longer possible to predict and analyze the timing for all possible operating conditions.

Currently the scope of this document is limited to analysis and design of a well-known system until its delivered. Future extensions will cover possibilities for timing analysis of systems with a high levels of uncertainty introduces by the adaptability of the AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform.

docs.title: 13. 时序的基础概念
docs.text: 原文标题：Basic Concepts of Timing

docs.title: 14. 时序需求 and 抽象 Levels
docs.text:
原文标题：Timing Requirements and Abstraction Levels

Timing properties described in the previous section have to be taken into account all along the specification and design process. In the specification phase, these timing properties are expressed as timing requirements on the system functions and decomposed during the system specification and design phases. In order to achieve this decomposition, it is better to follow some methodological principles. The following chapters of this document will present in more details these principles through the description of use cases. This section gives the definitions of the main timing abstraction levels considered in this document. It also gives some preliminary rules for applying timing requirements decomposition throughout these abstraction levels.

docs.title: 15. 时序抽象 Levels
docs.text:
原文标题：Timing Abstraction Levels

In this document, we will consider the following main timing abstraction levels corresponding to different levels of abstraction of platforms:

  • Functional Level This abstraction level is out of AUTOSAR modeling scope but is of primary importance to capture timing requirements from the early specification phases. It consists in an abstract architecture of the system functions.
  • Abstract Platform Level This abstraction level is in the AUTOSAR modeling scope. It consists of a description of an architecture of abstract components. These components are platform agnostic and can be mapped to any concrete platform (AUTOSAR or non AUTOSAR platforms).
  • Concrete Platform Level This abstraction level corresponds, in the scope of AUTOSAR, to Classic Platform or Adaptive Platform, and can also correspond to a non AUTOSAR concrete platform (e.g. COVESA).

Timing requirements decomposition has to be coherent between these levels of abstraction. A minimal set of guidelines shall be followed to ensure this coherence. Among these guidelines, it is important to distinguish concepts of decomposition and transformation.

docs.title: 16. Chaining Decompositions and Transformations
docs.text:
In this document, we will consider two kinds of transitions: transformation and decomposition. These are used in the following context and definitions.

  • Decomposition A decomposition consists in splitting a component or a timing requirement (more generally an artifact) at a given level of abstraction (either at functional-level, or abstract platform level or at a concrete platform level). A decomposition is a result of a design or organizational decision.
  • Transformation A transformation is a mapping. It is based on a set of rules describing how one (or many) source concepts are transformed into one (or many) target concepts. In this document we consider that transformations are used between different levels of abstraction (e.g. a transformation from functional level to abstract platform level, or a transformation from an abstract platform level to a concrete platform level). Once the mapping rules are defined, a transformation can be automated, e.g. by creation of elements on lower layer.

In order to simplify the transition between levels of abstraction and ensure a coherent timing requirements decomposition the following guidelines are recommended:

……本章内容较长已节选，完整内容见「本地文件」中的纯文本全文。

docs.title: 17. 基础概念 of Real Time Architectures
docs.text: 原文标题：Basic Concepts of Real Time Architectures

docs.title: 18. Real Time 架构定义
docs.text:
原文标题：Real Time Architecture Definition

An E/E architecture is the result of early design decisions that are necessary before a group of stakeholders can collaboratively build a system. An architecture defines the constituents (such as components, subsystems, ECUs, functions, compilation units ...) and the relevant relations (such as "calls", "sends data to", "synchronizes with", "uses", "depends on" ...) among them. In addition to the above-mentioned structural aspects, a real-time architecture shall provide means to fulfill timing requirements. Like for the system's constituents, real-time architecting consists of decomposing timing requirements and identifying relationships (such as refinement and traceability) among them. In fact, the timing requirements decomposition is a consequence of the structural decomposition where timing requirements are in part inherited by the decomposed units. However, while structural decomposition could be driven by functional concerns, input/output data flows, and/or provided/required services, timing decomposition is a more complex task to achieve. Correct timing requirement decomposition must be locally and globally feasible.

……本章内容较长已节选，完整内容见「本地文件」中的纯文本全文。

docs.title: 19. Execution and Transmission Times
docs.text:
The execution time of a Schedulable Entity is the duration taken by the Schedulable Entity to complete its execution on a computing resource (e.g. ECU). When referring to execution time we mean the net execution time. It only includes the duration a Schedulable Entity is actually executed on the computing resource. Not included is the time where it may be suspended or preempted due to other Schedulable Entities sharing the same computing resource, the setup time required to prepare the computing resource on the start or when resuming the execution of a Schedulable Entity.

Similarly, the transmission time of a signal/message/frame on a communication resource (e.g. bus, network) is the duration taken by the signal/message/frame to transit from its source to its destination without any consideration of other signals/messages/frames transiting on the same communication resource.

An execution/transmission time is a quantitative property that can be described with the following characteristics:

  • A statistical qualifier (worst, best, mean/average) representing the bounds of execution/transmission time.

……本章内容较长已节选，完整内容见「本地文件」中的纯文本全文。

docs.title: 20. Response Time
docs.text:
The response time of a Schedulable Entity is the time duration taken by the Schedulable Entity to complete its execution. Unlike for execution time, the response time takes into account other Schedulable Entities that are sharing the same execution/communication resource. Hence, the response time of a Schedulable Entity comprises its execution time and additional terms induced by the concurrent access to shared resources (blocking times, jitters...). See Chapter for more details.

An end-to-end response time is a response time in which several Schedulable Entities are involved. These Schedulable Entities form a chain. First Schedulable Entity of the chain is called the source Schedulable Entity and the last one is called the sink Schedulable Entity. The end-to-end response time is the elapsed time until the sink Schedulable Entity of the chain terminates its execution.

Like an execution time, a response time is a quantitative property that can be described with the following characteristics:

  • A statistical qualifier (worst, best and mean/average).

……本章内容较长已节选，完整内容见「本地文件」中的纯文本全文。

docs.title: 21. Relation between 时序 and 数据 Flow
docs.text:
原文标题：Relation between Timing and Data Flow

The functional behavior of a real-time system can not only be affected by its end-to-end timing behavior but also by its internal data flow. A cause-effect chain represents the data flow among communicating components, by relating read events of a consumer component to the corresponding write events of a producer component. Depending on the abstraction level, a component might be a functional block, a software component, or a Schedulable Entity.

It is important to mention that the specific data flow is observed on job-level. Take Figure as an example. It shows a cause-effect chain of three periodic real-time tasks (Schedulable Entities). The different execution instances of Schedulable Entities are called jobs. With implicit communication, each job reads its input at the beginning of its execution, executes on that data, and writes (publishes) the results after completion. This behavior varies for every job, because the physical execution times of Schedulable Entities are affected by a multitude of influences. Typical reasons are: input data, execution cycle, hardware platform, and scheduling design.

……本章内容较长已节选，完整内容见「本地文件」中的纯文本全文。

docs.title: 22. Logical Execution Time and data-flow determinism
docs.text:
Response times are statistical qualifiers in the sense of Section , meaning that the time that a Schedulable Entity takes for completion may jitter. Consequently, the times when Schedulable Entities read and write data may also jitter. A cause-effect chain is a chain in which the outcome of one entity influences the behavior of the next entity in the chain. The motivation of a logical timing abstraction is the observation that the relevant behavior of real-time programs is determined by the data flow within a cause-effect chain. For this data flow, it is only important when inputs are read and outputs are written, and not when programs complete code execution.

The concept of a cause-effect chain allows specifying a unique data flow between the entities of a chain. Such a unique data flow is called a deterministic data flow and the related property is data-flow determinism. Data-flow determinism guarantees that the behavior of a chain is preserved under any platform execution. Data-flow determinism is an important basic concept of real-time architectures, because it increases design predictability, robustness, and portability.

……本章内容较长已节选，完整内容见「本地文件」中的纯文本全文。

docs.title: 23. Languages for 时序需求规范
docs.text:
原文标题：Languages for Timing Requirements Specification

The AUTOSAR methodology is based on the AUTOSAR language and its timing extensions. AUTOSAR is the language for the software implementation levels but not applicable at the functional levels (analysis and design). Therefore, in order to ensure a complete model-based approach for timing requirements decomposition, a complementary modeling language for functional levels has to be used. EAST-ADL2 and its timing extension TADL2 allow functional levels specification with precise timing models. Moreover, TADL2 and AUTOSAR Timing extensions are sharing the same base concepts which may facilitate the translation of timing requirements from the functional level to the AUTOSAR level (where timing requirements are expressed with TIMEX).

Therefore, EAST-ADL / TADL is briefly presented as an example of modeling language for the support of the functional levels of a methodology for timing requirements decomposition.

docs.title: 24. EAST-ADL / TADL
docs.text:
EAST-ADL is an Architecture Description Language (ADL) for automotive embedded systems, developed in several European research projects. It is designed to complement AUTOSAR with descriptions at higher level of abstractions. Aspects covered by EAST-ADL include vehicle features, functions, requirements, variability, software components, hardware components and communication.

TADL2 (Timing Augmented Description Language) language concepts can be used in specific steps of the GMP (Generic Methodology Pattern, see section ) methodology to describe timing information. TADL2 allows the specification of timing constraints that may express the following timing properties/requirements:

  • Execution Time (Worst-case, Best-case, Simulated, Measured)
  • End-to-end Latency
  • Sampling Rates
  • Time Budget
  • Response Time
  • Communication Delay
  • Slack
  • Repetition pattern
  • Synchronization
  • ...

TADL2 base concepts are quite equivalent to those of AUTOSAR TIMEX presented in the following section.

docs.title: 25. 基础概念 of AUTOSAR TIMEX
docs.text:
原文标题：Basic concepts of AUTOSAR TIMEX

According to , the primary purpose of the timing extensions is to support constructing embedded real-time systems that satisfy given timing requirements and to perform timing analysis/validations of those systems once they have been built.

The AUTOSAR Timing Extensions provide a timing model as specification basis for a contract based development process, in which the development is carried out by different organizations in different locations and time frames. The constraints entered in the early phase of the project (when corresponding solutions are not developed yet) shall be seen as extra-functional requirements agreed upon by the development partners.

This way the timing specification supports a top-down design methodology. However, due to the fact that a pure top-down design is not feasible in most of the cases (e.g. because of legacy code), the timing specification allows the bottom-up design methodology as well.

The resulting overall specification (AUTOSAR Model and Timing Extensions) shall enable the analysis of a system's timing behavior and the validation of the analysis results against timing constraints.

……本章内容较长已节选，完整内容见「本地文件」中的纯文本全文。

docs.title: 26. TIMEX Work Products
docs.text:
The following part decribes the different TIMEX Work Products to provide a general overview on them. Further, much more detailed descriptions are given in .

Events. The notion of Event is used to describe that specific observable events occur in a system and also at which locations in this system the occurrences are observed. These are related to predefined Event types and are used to specify different actions (eg. Read/Write data to ports, Send/Receive data via network, Start/Terminate executables ...).

Event Chains specify a causal relationship between two Events. For example Event B occurs if and only if Event A occurred before.

Timing Constraints imposed on Events. Event Triggering Constraint imposes a constraint on the occurrences of an Event in a temporal space (periodic, sporadic, specific pattern).

Timing Constraints imposed on Event Chains. Event Triggering Constraints are used to specify a reaction or age, e.g the maximum distance of two following events. Latency and synchronization timing constraints specify that a stimuli or response event must occur within a given time interval (tolerance) to be said to occur simultaneous and synchronous respectively.

……本章内容较长已节选，完整内容见「本地文件」中的纯文本全文。

docs.title: 27. 时序需求 on 设计 Levels
docs.text:
原文标题：Timing Requirements on Design Levels

The decomposition of timing requirements is a primary concern for the design and analysis of a real-time system. At the beginning of the system design process, timing requirements are expressed at the level of the customer functionality identified in the specification. The development of the customer functionality requires its decomposition into small and manageable components. This decomposition activity called architecting implies also a decomposition of timing requirements attached to the decomposed functionality. This chapter gives an overview of the proposed approach for the decomposition of timing requirements.

docs.title: 28. 时序需求 Decomposition Problem
docs.text:
原文标题：Timing Requirements Decomposition Problem

Mastering timing requirements is one key success factor for the development and integration of state of the art automotive E/E-systems. Timing requirements should be monitored continuously during the complex development process of a vehicle, and further shall be reused and communicated for the re-use of functions or components to other vehicle projects: timing requirements have to be described systematically and carefully. The required level of detail can vary from timing constraints for high level customer related features at the vehicle level, over timing requirements for the control of a power amplifier for a particular actuator, to ECU-internal timing for data synchronicity of software functions on a multi-core microcontroller at the operational level. As illustrated in Figure , the development process follows the well-known V-model, which describes a systematic and staggered top-down approach from system specifications to system integration. On the left branch process steps of specification are described, implementing decomposition from an entire E/E-system to single components. The base of the V describes implementation and associated test procedures.

……本章内容较长已节选，完整内容见「本地文件」中的纯文本全文。

docs.title: 29. Hierarchical 时序描述
docs.text:
原文标题：Hierarchical Timing Description

During the early design phase of an automotive development process the architecture discussion is about high level customer related functions. These functions can be detailed in functional "cause and effect" or "activity" chains, which from a temporal view can be budgeted - justified by customer's experience. The functional quality and thus technical effort dedicated to the customer's experience is a business decision of a company. In the AFS example this is the reaction time from the detection by the yaw rate sensor to the motor control of the steering system. This avoids instable behavior during driving in curves.

An other example is a powertrain or chassis control function which can cause inconveniences like bucking during shifting or braking.

From methodological and technical view timing analysis is a tool to assure the desired temporal behavior during the mapping of a functional network to a component network as depicted on Figure .

Once the major timing budgets for customer related functions are defined and a distribution of functional parts to hardware components is done , a more detailed temporal view of a networking architecture can be made.

▎1000 问全景（问题库）

▎ 基础语法与数据类型

  1. 声明（declaration）和定义（definition）的区别是什么？为什么这个区别在C里比在其他语言里更重要？

  2. int在不同平台上可能是16位、32位或64位——写可移植代码时应该怎么处理整型长度问题？

  3. unsigned和signed之间做算术运算时，C语言怎么隐式转换？什么情况下会出问题？

  4. 浮点数float和double在内存里的存储格式（IEEE 754）是什么样的？判断两个浮点数是否相等为什么不能直接写==？

▎ 存储类与作用域

  1. auto、register、static、extern这四种存储类分别控制变量的什么属性？

  2. static修饰局部变量、全局变量和函数时，行为各是什么？为什么static在C里被"重载"了？

  3. const修饰变量和const修饰指针（const int *p vs int *const p）——编译器各保证了什么？

  4. volatile是干什么的？它在嵌入式开发里最典型的场景有哪些？去掉volatile编译器会优化掉什么？

▎ 指针

  1. 指针到底是什么？它存的地址和这个地址上的内容为什么是两回事？

  2. 指针加减整数（p+1）时，地址到底加了几个字节？这个机制跟指针类型有什么关系？

  3. NULL指针、野指针、悬空指针（dangling pointer）——三种指针各是怎么产生的？怎么避免？

  4. 函数指针是什么？把它作为回调函数使用时，编译器帮你做了什么？

  5. 二级指针（int **p）在什么场景下必须用？只用一级指针代替会出什么问题？

▎ 数组与字符串

  1. 数组名和指针是一回事吗？为什么sizeof(arr)和sizeof(ptr)结果不一样？

  2. C语言为什么没有内置的字符串类型？以'\0'结尾的字符串设计带来了哪些问题？

  3. strcpy、strcat、sprintf为什么被称为"不安全"的函数？它们的安全替代版本是怎么解决长度问题的？

  4. 二维数组在内存里是怎么排列的？为什么访问arr[i][j]时，维度的顺序对性能有影响？

▎ 结构体与联合体

  1. 结构体内存对齐（alignment）是怎么回事？为什么编译器会在成员之间插入填充字节？

  2. 位域（bit field）在什么场景下有用？用位域和手动按位操作各有什么优缺点？

  3. 联合体（union）和结构体（struct）在内存布局上有什么本质区别？联合体最常见的用途是什么？

  4. 结构体作为函数参数传值（pass by value）和传指针（pass by pointer）在性能上差在哪？

▎ 内存管理

  1. 堆（heap）和栈（stack）在C语言运行时里是怎么管理的？谁分配谁释放？

  2. malloc的底层实现大概是怎么工作的？为什么malloc不一定每次调用都会去问操作系统要内存？

  3. malloc之后必须free——"内存泄漏"具体是什么样的？一个程序泄漏了会怎么样？

  4. 什么是"内存碎片"？为什么长时间运行的嵌入式系统要尽量避免动态内存分配？

▎ 位操作

  1. 移位运算（<<和>>）在符号数和无符号数上的行为一样吗？右移有符号数是算术移位还是逻辑移位？

  2. 用位操作实现"取一个整数二进制表示中的第n位"——表达式怎么写？它和掩码（mask）的关系是什么？

  3. 嵌入式驱动中常见的"读-改-写"模式（如设置某个寄存器的某几位）——用位操作怎么实现才算安全？

▎ 预处理器

  1. define定义的宏和真正的函数有什么本质区别？宏的"副作用问题"（如MAX(a++, b)）是怎么产生的？

  2. 头文件里的 Include Guard 是干什么的？如果不加，编译器会遇到什么问题？

  3. pragma once和Include Guard比有什么优缺点？为什么有些项目坚持用Include Guard？

▎ 文件I/O

  1. fopen的"文本模式"和"二进制模式"在Windows和Linux上的行为有什么不同？这跟换行符'\n'的表示有什么关系？

  2. fgets和gets有什么区别？为什么gets已经从C11标准里被移除了？

  3. fread和fwrite的"块读写"设计——一次读4个256字节的块和一次读1个1024字节的块，性能一样吗？

  4. 文件指针（FILE *）和文件描述符（fd）——C标准库的IO函数和系统调用read/write之间隔了几层？

▎ 可变参数

  1. printf是怎么知道传入了多少个参数的？va_list、va_start、va_arg、va_end的机制是什么？

  2. 自己写一个可变参数函数时，为什么必须有一个固定参数来确定可变参数的起始位置？

  3. 可变参数函数为什么是"类型不安全"的？printf传错参数类型时，那个崩溃是怎么发生的？

▎ 函数与递归

  1. 函数调用时，栈帧（stack frame）里存了哪些内容？返回地址和局部变量的布局是怎么样的？

  2. 递归函数为什么不遇到终止条件就会栈溢出？递归和非递归（迭代）之间，除了写法还有什么本质区别？

  3. 尾递归优化（tail call optimization）是什么？它解决了递归的什么问题？编译器怎么知道可以做这个优化？

▎ 多文件组织与模块化

  1. 头文件应该放声明还是定义？为什么在头文件里定义全局变量会有"多重定义"问题？

  2. "前向声明"和"环形依赖"——两个头文件互相包含时为什么会编译失败？怎么解决？

  3. static函数在模块化编程里起什么作用？它和普通函数在链接时有什么不同？

▎ 未定义行为与常见陷阱

  1. 什么是C语言的"未定义行为"（undefined behavior）？为什么C有这么多UB而其他语言没有？

  2. 缓冲区溢出（buffer overflow）是怎么发生的？一个简单的gets()如何能让攻击者改写返回地址？

  3. 整数溢出（overflow）在符号数和无符号数上的行为分别是定义的还是未定义的？

  4. 序列点（sequence point）是什么？为什么i=i++是未定义行为？

  5. 看一段代码判断它有没有未定义行为——为什么这种能力区分了"会写C"和"真正懂C"？

▎ 标准库深入（stdlib.h / string.h / math.h）

  1. qsort排序需要一个比较函数指针——为什么标准库不直接内置一个默认的升序比较器？void *参数在这里解决了什么问题？

  2. bsearch（二分查找）要求数组是"已排序的"——如果传入一个未排序的数组，bsearch会怎么样？它能检测出来吗？

  3. atoi把一个字符串转成整数，如果传入"abc"会返回什么？atoi、strtol、sscanf三者在错误处理上有什么不同？

▎ 编译与链接

  1. 从.c文件到可执行文件，经历了哪几个阶段？每个阶段产出了什么？

  2. 静态链接和动态链接的本质区别是什么？嵌入式系统里为什么通常用静态链接？

  3. "符号解析"和"重定位"在链接器里各做了什么？链接错误中的"undefined reference"和"multiple definition"分别发生在哪个阶段？

  4. 为什么在头文件里定义全局变量并让多个.c文件包含，链接时会报多重定义？但如果加上static或inline就不会？

▎ 高级特性

  1. restrict关键字是干什么的？它对编译器优化有什么帮助？不加restrict的话编译器不敢做什么假设？

  2. 柔性数组成员（flexible array member）——struct的最后一个成员写成char data[]而不是char *data，两者在内存布局和分配方式上有什么不同？

  3. C11引入的_Generic泛型选择——它是怎么让一个宏根据参数类型展开不同代码的？跟C++的重载比，它缺了什么？

▎ 防御性编程与安全

  1. assert和static_assert的区别是什么？为什么说static_assert比assert更适合在嵌入式里做编译时检查？

  2. MISRA C的核心规则可以归结为哪几条原则？它为什么要禁止动态内存分配（malloc/free）？

  3. 什么是"永不失败的函数"和"可能失败的函数"的接口设计约定？在C里怎么用返回值表达错误？

  4. 用errno报告错误和使用自定义错误枚举各有什么优缺点？AUTOSAR的Std_ReturnType走的是哪种风格？

▎ 非局部跳转（setjmp / longjmp）

  1. setjmp/longjmp是干什么的？它和goto有什么本质区别？为什么说它是C里的"异常处理"？

  2. longjmp跳回setjmp的位置后，栈上的局部变量会恢复成原来的值还是当前的值？这跟volatile有什么关系？

  3. 在嵌入式里用setjmp/longjmp做错误恢复时有什么风险？什么场景下它是合理的？

▎ 信号处理（signal.h）

  1. 信号（signal）在C语言层面和在操作系统层面分别是什么？SIGSEGV（段错误）是怎么产生的？

  2. 信号处理函数里能做什么、不能做什么？为什么说在信号处理函数里调用printf是危险的？

  3. 什么是"异步信号安全"（async-signal-safe）函数？在嵌入式里，一个ISR和一个信号处理函数，谁的限制更多？

▎ C标准演变

  1. C89、C99、C11、C17、C23——每个版本最重要的一条改变是什么？为什么C99被认为是C的"爆发版本"？

  2. C11引入的_Noreturn函数说明符是干什么的？它告诉编译器和程序员什么信息？

  3. bool类型从C99的_Bool到C23可以直接用bool——这个演变过程反映了C标准委员会什么样的设计哲学？

▎ 内联函数与VLA

  1. inline关键字在C和C++里的行为有什么不同？C里加了inline的函数为什么还要在某个.c文件里显式实例化一次？

  2. 变长数组（VLA）是C99引入的——它的长度在编译时未知，那它在栈上怎么分配？为什么C11把VLA改成了"可选特性"？

▎ C与C++互操作

  1. extern "C"是干什么的？为什么C和C++链接同一个.o文件时会出现undefined reference？

  2. 一个在C里合法的函数指针赋值（如void *p = malloc）在C++里为什么需要强制转换？这反映了C和C++在类型系统上的什么差异？

▎ 对齐深入

  1. alignas和alignof是C11引入的——在没有它们之前，嵌入式开发者怎么手动对齐缓冲区到4字节或32字节边界？

  2. 缓存行对齐（cache line alignment，通常是64字节）为什么在多核或DMA场景下重要？不对齐会发生什么？

▎ 多线程与原子操作（C11）

  1. C11引入的thrd_create和pthread_create在接口设计上有什么不同？为什么C标准没有直接包装pthread？

  2. 什么是"数据竞争"（data race）？两个线程同时读一个变量的值，是数据竞争吗？

  3. atomic_int和用互斥量保护的int，在性能和行为上有什么本质区别？

  4. 内存顺序（memory_order_relaxed、acquire、release、seq_cst）——这四个级别的强度各在什么场景下用？

▎ 时间处理（time.h）

  1. time_t到底是个什么类型？为什么它通常是32位或64位的整数？2038年问题是怎么产生的？

  2. clock_gettime和time函数有什么区别？为什么测量代码性能时应该用前者而不是后者？

  3. 嵌入式系统里经常需要的"定时器回调"——用POSIX timer_create和直接用硬件定时器中断有什么区别？

▎ 复合字面量与泛型深入

  1. 复合字面量（compound literal，如(struct point){.x=1, .y=2}）是在栈上还是静态区？它的生命周期是多久？

  2. _Generic既然可以在编译期做类型分发，它能模拟"函数重载"吗？如果能，跟C++的重载比差在哪？

▎ 宽字符与本地化

  1. wchar_t在不同平台上的大小不一样（Linux上是4字节，Windows上是2字节）——这个不一致带来的最大麻烦是什么？

  2. char字符串和wchar_t字符串之间怎么转换？mbstowcs和wcstombs在底层发生了什么？

▎ 环境交互与工具

  1. getenv获取环境变量有什么安全风险？谁能修改环境变量？setenv和putenv的实现差异是什么？

  2. atexit注册的退出函数是在什么时候调用的？如果多个atexit函数，调用顺序是先进先出还是后进先出？

  3. 内存调试工具（valgrind、AddressSanitizer）是怎么检测到"内存泄漏"和"越界访问"的？它们各自对运行性能有多大影响？

▎ 常见库函数遗漏

  1. memmove和memcpy的区别是什么？为什么一个能处理重叠内存而另一个不能？

  2. snprintf的返回值含义——如果缓冲区太小导致字符串被截断，它返回的是"实际写了多少"还是"本来要写多少"？

  3. strtok为什么是"不可重入"的函数？strtok_r是怎么解决这个问题的？

▎ 编译实战（Makefile / 编译选项）

  1. 编译C程序时-O0、-O1、-O2、-O3、-Os这几个优化级别分别做了什么？在嵌入式调试时为什么通常先用-O0？

  2. -Wall -Wextra -Werror这三个编译选项各自有什么作用？为什么项目里常用-Werror把警告变成错误？

  3. Makefile里$@、$^、$<分别代表什么？一个最小可用的Makefile怎么写——只编译一个main.c和一个utils.c？

▎ 调试实战（GDB）

  1. GDB里break、watch、catch三种断点的区别是什么？watch在什么场景下特别有用？

  2. 程序core dump了——怎么用GDB的bt（backtrace）和frame命令定位崩溃位置？先看什么再看什么？

  3. GDB的print和display命令有什么不同？在for循环里想每次迭代都看某个变量的值，该用哪个？

▎ 安全编码实战

  1. sprintf和snprintf的返回值有什么区别？用snprintf是否就绝对安全了——如果传入的size参数比实际缓冲区大呢？

  2. 整数溢出不仅会导致计算结果错误，在分配内存时还会导致缓冲区溢出——malloc(n * sizeof(type))在n很大时为什么有风险？怎么防？

  3. C的字符串函数（strcpy、strcat、sprintf）的"不安全"本质是什么？用strncpy替代strcpy就安全了吗——strncpy不自动加'\0'的坑在哪？

▎ 性能分析实战

  1. 怎么判断你的C程序是CPU密集型的还是内存密集型的？perf top和gprof分别适合看什么？

  2. 内联函数和宏在性能优化上有什么区别？为什么编译器可能忽略你的inline关键字？

▎ 嵌入式C实战

  1. 嵌入式里常见的"寄存器位操作"模式——定义某个寄存器的某几位为A、某几位为B——C语言中怎么用宏封装一个"读-改-写"的通用模式？

  2. 链接脚本（.ld文件）里的.text、.data、.bss段分别放什么？为什么.bss段在可执行文件里不占空间但在RAM里要占？

▎ 跨平台C开发

  1. 代码要同时跑在x86 Linux和ARM Cortex-M上，int的大小不一样——怎么用C标准类型（int32_t、uint16_t）来保证跨平台一致？

  2. 大端和小端在不同的CPU上，通过CAN总线收了一个32位整数——怎么在C里安全地做字节序转换？

专栏⑭进度：导航 + 10/10篇 + 补充一~八（共 18 篇）✅ 全部完成

docs.title: 儿童教育 1000 问｜Flomo 原始专题迁移
docs.text:
本页保留原始专题导航与问题内容，作为 Wiki 的可追溯副本。

原始来源： https://v.flomoapp.com/mine/?memo_id=MjQ3NDI1NjAz 创建时间： 2026-07-18T21:12:53+08:00 最近更新： 2026-10-06T21:01:17+08:00 原文长度： 4503 字

儿童教育·从小学到大学学习系列 1000 问

▎ 核心理念

  1. 你2023年记过一套书——《Everything You Need to Ace》美国少年学霸超级笔记系列。这套书的核心思路是什么——把每个学科的知识点画成视觉化笔记，用"孩子能懂的语言"解释复杂概念。这套方法可以贯穿整个K-12教育？

  2. 教育的"长期主义"——小学做习惯、初中做方法、高中做策略、大学做方向。为什么说"小学成绩好不等于初中成绩好"？因为不同阶段需要的能力完全不同？

  3. 你在自己的学习中用"堆问题法"——这套方法能不能用在儿童教育上？让孩子对一个学科先有100个问题，带着问题去学，而不是被动接受知识点？

▎ 小学阶段：学习习惯的黄金期

语文

  1. 拼音教学——为什么很多孩子"b d p q"分不清？这是视觉辨别能力还没发育成熟，不是笨。怎么教——用形象记忆法（b像收音机、d像马蹄声）？

  2. 识字量障碍——小学毕业要求认识3000字左右。但"随文识字"（在读课文中认字）和"集中识字"（按字形规律批量认字）哪个更有效？为什么中国学校以随文识字为主（跟教材走）？

  3. 朗读的作用——为什么小学语文老师要求"有感情地朗读课文"？朗读是把视觉文字转化为听觉信息，帮助理解语感和句式？

  4. 阅读量——新课标要求：小学课外阅读总量不少于100万字。但"读得多"等于"读得好"吗？精读和泛读的比例应该是多少？

  5. 看图写话→作文——孩子从"写一句话"到"写一段话"到"写一篇文章"，卡住的地方通常不是一个——是"不知道写什么"。怎么教——先教观察方法（视觉/听觉/触觉），再教组织方法（时间顺序/空间顺序）？

数学

  1. 数感培养——什么是数感？不是算得快，是对数字有"感觉"——看到37+58能大致判断结果是90多，而不是100多。数感怎么培养——生活中用数学（购物算价格、分蛋糕讲分数）？

  2. 20以内加减法的"凑十法"和"破十法"——为什么被很多老师认为是小学一年级最重要的数学技能？因为它帮孩子理解十进制的基础？

  3. 应用题为什么是小学最大的拦路虎？因为应用题考的不是"算"，是"理解"——读不懂题、不知道用加还是用减。怎么解决——画图法（画线段图/示意图把文字变成图像）？

  4. 乘法口诀——"三七二十一"是背出来的还是理解出来的？死记硬背和意义记忆哪个更有效——先理解（3个7连加），再背诵（加速计算）？

  5. 小学奥数要不要学？对数学思维有帮助还是扼杀兴趣？什么样的孩子适合奥数（学有余力、对数学有好奇心），什么样的不适合（基础题还做错、越做越怕数学）？

英语

  1. 英语启蒙的"听力先行"——为什么母语者能说流利英语但很多中国学生学了10年开不了口？因为母语者先听够了（1000+小时的可理解输入）才说。中国孩子英语启蒙的第一件事应该是听还是背单词？

  2. 自然拼读（Phonics） vs 国际音标——哪个更适合小学阶段？自然拼读覆盖了约80%的英语发音规则，适合"见词能读"；国际音标更精确但需要额外的符号记忆。前三年用Phonics启蒙，三年级后引入音标？

  3. 分级阅读——RAZ/牛津阅读树/海尼曼——这些分级体系的核心逻辑是什么？"i+1"理论——在现有水平上只加一点点新内容。为什么孩子愿意反复读同一本书（因为重复是儿童学习的核心机制）？

  4. 英语积累的量——要达到高考135分，小学毕业需要达到什么水平？RAZ读到什么级别？词汇量多少？很多英语牛娃小学毕业词汇量3000+（相当于中考水平）——是天赋还是方法？

▎ 初中阶段：学习方法的定型期

学习方法转型

  1. 初中和小学最核心的区别是什么——小学是"3门课"，初中是"8门课"（语数英+物化生+史政）。科目突然变多，时间不够用了——怎么帮孩子做"时间预算"和"优先级管理"？

  2. 预习→听课→复习→作业→考试——为什么很多初中生只做了"听课+作业"两步？预习和复习是最容易被忽略但最有效的环节。怎么让孩子养成预习习惯——5分钟快速浏览课本，画出"会的"和"不会的"？

  3. 错题本——见过90%的初中生有错题本，但90%的错题本从期中之后就再没翻过。有效的错题本怎么做——不抄题（剪下来或直接标记在原卷上），只记录错因和正确思路？

  4. 第一次出现"我真笨"的自我否定——初中数学从"计算"转向"逻辑推理"，很多小学成绩好的孩子突然跟不上。怎么应对——不是"多做题"，是"把思路讲出来"（费曼学习法）？

物理——全新的理科思维

  1. 物理为什么是初中最"难"的学科？因为它要求"在脑子里建立一个看不见的物理世界"（力怎么在物体上作用、电场看不见摸不着）。怎么帮孩子建立物理直觉——做实验、看实验视频、用生活中的例子解释概念？

  2. 电学的第一步——电路图是抽象的，但电流是物理的。从"小灯泡亮不亮"到"欧姆定律U=IR"——这条认知路径上最容易卡住的地方是什么（不理解电压是"推动力"，电阻是"阻力"）？

初中英语的转折点

  1. 初中英语和小学英语的本质区别——小学是"活的"（唱歌、画画、玩游戏），初中是"死的"（语法、单选、完形填空）。怎么让孩子接受——语法不是"规则"，是"语言的地图"？

  2. 背单词方法的升级——小学靠自然拼读和图片记忆，初中需要词根词缀。英语有多少常用词根——大约250个能覆盖80%的学术词汇。先学词根还是先背单词——先学常见的50个词根（port=拿、spect=看、dict=说）？

青春期与学习

  1. 初中正是青春期——孩子最不想听爸妈讲学习的时候。怎么在这三年保持沟通——少说"你这次考了多少"，多说"你觉得这学期最难的是哪一科"？

  2. 电子设备——手机/平板/游戏。完全禁止还是合理使用？什么情况下"玩手机"会影响学习（睡前1小时还在刷手机→睡眠不足→第二天困）？什么情况下"玩手机"不一定是坏事（好的学习App/查资料/英语听力）？

▎ 高中阶段：考试策略的决胜期

理科学习策略

  1. 高中理科和初中的区别——从"记忆理解"到"推理应用"。高中数学题，你永远不会见到跟你做过的同一道题——所以"刷题"到底在刷什么（刷出题感，不是刷答案）？

  2. 物理的"模型思维"——高中物理题可以归类为几百个模型（斜面模型、传送带模型、碰撞模型、天体运动模型）。用模型解题为什么比盲目做题更高效——先判断题目属于哪个模型，再用这个模型的解法快速推进？

  3. 化学的"三重表征"——宏观（看到的颜色变化/气体）、微观（分子原子怎么运动）、符号（化学方程式表达）。化学学不好的根源往往在哪——只记了符号，没有建立宏观和微观的对应关系？

  4. 生物的"理科还是文科"之争——生物确实需要记大量术语，但理解核心逻辑（进化论/细胞学说/基因中心法则）比死记硬背更重要。怎么教——用故事串起知识点？

文科学习策略

  1. 语文的分数不上不下——古诗文默写满分、阅读理解扣一半。阅读理解到底考什么——"作者写了什么"（事实）+ "作者为什么这么写"（意图）+ "你觉得好不好"（评价）。这三个层次的哪个最关键——"作者为什么这么写"（大多数扣分在这里）？

  2. 英语的"冲击135+"——英语卷子越来越像"用英语考逻辑"。阅读理解的C篇D篇看不懂不是因为单词不认识，是因为 长难句断不开。怎么训练——真题的阅读文章每篇都做"长难句拆解"（主谓宾→从句→修饰）？

  3. 历史和政治——死记硬背能及格不能得高分。历史要建立"时间轴+空间轴"的双轴体系，政治要理解"为什么国家要这样管"（不是背政策，是理解政策背后的逻辑）？

考试策略

  1. 高考的核心不是"你会不会"，是"你在有限时间内的得分效率"。怎么帮孩子理解——一道压轴大题15分用30分钟，还是三道中档题各5分用15分钟——后者的得分效率更高？

  2. 模考的作用——不是为了看分数，是为了找"知识盲区"。每次模考后做"失分归类"：粗心（计算错误/看错题）+ 概念不清（知识点没理解）+ 能力不足（确实不会做）。这三类中哪一类最容易通过短期训练改善——粗心（训练检查习惯）？

  3. 睡眠的重要性——高中生的常见误区：熬夜=努力。但睡眠不足导致记忆力下降、注意力不集中、情绪波动——实质上降低了学习效率。有没有数据支持——每天睡足7小时的学生比睡5小时的学生平均高考成绩高多少？

▎ 大学阶段：自主学习的起点

  1. 从"被安排"到"自己安排"——大学没人催你交作业、没人盯着你上课。怎么帮孩子提前适应——高一开始就要培养"自己的时间自己管"的能力？

  2. 专业选择的思路——"选热门的专业的" vs "选自己喜欢的" vs "选好找工作的"。三个标准之间有没有一个更好的决策框架——用你记过的"选不如删"原则？

  3. 大学里的核心能力——自学能力。所有大学知识，毕业后5年基本过时，但自学能力不会。怎么在大学培养自学能力——从大一开始：选一门课自学（不用去上课、只看MOOC/教材/论文，拿到同样的分数）？

▎ 家长角色与沟通

  1. 你的身份——你正在思考如何从小学到大学系统性地规划孩子的教育。你不是教育家，但你是一个"用方法论解决问题"的人——跟你做嵌入式项目一样的思路：先有系统架构，再有详细设计，最后是调试和迭代？

  2. 教育的最重要一条原则——你给孩子最好的礼物不是"帮他做作业"，是"让他学会自己做作业"？从小学一年级开始"陪写作业"到什么时候——慢慢从"全陪"（一年级）到"半陪"（二年级）到"只检查"（三年级）到"完全不管"（四年级）？

  3. 犯错的权利——孩子做错题、考砸了、作业忘带了——这是坏事吗？还是——这恰恰是他学习"后果管理"的机会？

  4. "别人家的孩子"——不比较几乎不可能，但怎么让比较变得"还能吸收"？看到别人家的优点不是用来否定自己的孩子——是用来给他打开一扇窗户（"你看小明英语口语那么好，你猜他是怎么练的？"）？

▎ 你已有的相关资源

你2023年8月记过**《Everything You Need to Ace》美国少年学霸超级笔记九册**——这套书覆盖了初中到高中的数学、科学、英语、历史等核心学科，用视觉化思维导图的方式呈现知识点。这个系列可以作为你构建儿童教育体系的"参照物"——从它的思路里提取"可视化学习"的方法论，再结合你自己实践的"堆问题"法，形成一套独特的儿童教育内容体系？

你也可以把今天你学习的"堆问题法"移植给孩子——让他对一个学科先提出100个"我好奇的问题"，每个问题都是一扇门，而不是让他背100个"答案"。这可能比任何一种培训班都更有效？

docs.title: 电气工程及其自动化 10000 问｜Flomo 原始内容迁移
docs.text:
电气工程及其自动化问题库。此页保留 Flomo 原始内容与来源，作为 Wiki 副本。

原始来源： https://v.flomoapp.com/mine/?memo_id=MjQ2Mzc1MTM2 创建时间： 2026-07-12T10:55:38+08:00 最近更新： 2026-10-06T21:01:17+08:00 原文长度： 11599 字

记录电气工程及其自动化学习的10000个问题：

电路原理基础

  1. 基尔霍夫电流定律（KCL）和电压定律（KVL）在本质上分别守恒了什么？为什么这两个定律是电路分析的"宪法"？

  2. 戴维南定理和诺顿定理说的是同一件事吗？任何一个线性含源二端网络，都可以等效成一个电压源+电阻或电流源+电阻——这个等效在实际设计里有什么用？

  3. 电容和电感的"储能"是怎么工作的？为什么在直流稳态里，电容相当于"开路"、电感相当于"短路"？

  4. RLC串联电路的谐振频率是怎么算出来的？谐振时电压和电流的相位关系是什么？

▎ 模拟电子技术

  1. 二极管的最核心特性是什么？"单向导电"在IV特性曲线上怎么体现？正向压降（0.7V）是怎么来的？

  2. 三极管（BJT）的放大原理——一个小电流怎么控制一个大电流？"放大"的能量从哪里来？

  3. 运算放大器的"虚短"和"虚断"是怎么推导出来的？为什么同相输入端和反相输入端可以看成"电压相等"？

  4. 一个反相比例放大电路的放大倍数是由哪两个电阻决定的？如果feedback电阻是100kΩ、输入电阻是10kΩ，放大倍数是多少？

▎ 数字电子技术

  1. 与门、或门、非门——这三个基本逻辑门能组合出任何逻辑电路吗？为什么说它们是"完备的"？

  2. 触发器和锁存器的区别是什么？为什么D触发器是数字电路中最常用的存储单元？

  3. 组合逻辑和时序逻辑的本质区别是什么？"当前输出只取决于当前输入"和"还取决于之前的状态"——各对应哪一类？

▎ 自动控制原理

  1. "开环控制"和"闭环控制"（反馈控制）的本质区别是什么？为什么说反馈是自动控制的基石？

  2. 传递函数是什么？为什么控制工程师喜欢用拉普拉斯变换把微分方程变成代数方程来处理？

  3. PID控制器为什么应用这么广？P、I、D三个分量各自的作用分别是什么？

  4. 系统的"稳定性"是什么意思？一个不稳定的系统长什么样——举例说明？

  5. 根轨迹法是怎么判断系统稳定性的？闭环极点落在s平面的左半平面为什么就是稳定的？

▎ 电机与拖动

  1. 直流电机的转速和什么有关？为什么说直流电机"调压调速"和"调磁调速"的原理不同？

  2. 异步电机（感应电机）的"转差率"是什么意思？为什么异步电机的转速永远小于同步转速？

  3. 步进电机的"步距角"和什么有关？为什么步进电机可以开环精确定位？

  4. 电机的"转矩-转速特性"曲线——直流电机、异步电机、同步电机各自的曲线形状有什么不同？

▎ 电力电子技术

  1. 整流电路（AC→DC）——不控整流和可控整流的区别是什么？晶闸管（SCR）在可控整流里起了什么作用？

  2. 逆变电路（DC→AC）——PWM逆变是怎么把直流电变成交流电的？为什么输出波形不是完美的正弦波？

  3. 升压（Boost）和降压（Buck）DC-DC变换器的基本原理是什么？为什么开关电源比线性电源效率高？

▎ 信号与系统

  1. 连续信号和离散信号的本质区别是什么？为什么计算机只能处理离散信号？

  2. 傅里叶变换在做什么？为什么说它把一个时域信号变成了频域信号？

  3. 采样定理（奈奎斯特-香农）说采样频率必须大于信号最高频率的两倍——如果低于这个值会发生什么？

▎ 电力系统分析

  1. 电力系统为什么要用"标幺值"（per-unit system）来计算？用实际值算跟用标幺值算，差别在哪？

  2. 潮流计算（Power Flow）在算什么？一个节点有 P、Q、V、θ 四个量，一般给定哪两个、求解哪两个？

  3. 什么叫"短路"？三相短路、两相短路、单相接地短路——哪种最严重、哪种最常发生？

▎ 继电保护

  1. 继电保护的"四性"（选择性、速动性、灵敏性、可靠性）——这四个指标之间有没有矛盾？比如速动性和选择性怎么平衡？

  2. 电流保护的 I 段（无时限速断）、II 段（限时速断）、III 段（过电流）——三段保护在动作时间和保护范围上分别怎么配合？

  3. 差动保护为什么被认为是"最灵敏"的保护？它靠比较两端的电流之差来动作——那正常运行和区外故障时为什么不误动？

▎ PLC 与工控

  1. PLC 的扫描周期（scan cycle）包含哪几个阶段？为什么说 PLC 是"循环执行"而不是像单片机那样"事件驱动"？

  2. 梯形图（Ladder Diagram）里的"常开触点"和"常闭触点"在硬件继电器和软件里分别是怎么对应的？为什么梯形图里经常出现"自锁"电路？

▎ 高电压与绝缘技术

  1. 为什么高压输电要用交流而不是直流？那现在为什么又要发展特高压直流输电（UHVDC）？

  2. 什么是"局部放电"（partial discharge）？一个看起来完好的绝缘体内部可能在悄悄放电——怎么检测出来？

▎ 传感器与检测技术

  1. 电阻式、电容式、电感式传感器——三种原理分别适合测什么物理量？为什么工业现场温度传感器用得最多的是热电偶和PT100？

  2. 什么是"测量系统的静态特性"和"动态特性"？一个温度传感器标称"精度±0.5%FS"——这个FS是满量程的意思，那量程选大选小对实际测量误差有什么影响？

▎ 电力拖动自动控制系统

  1. 直流调速系统的"双闭环"（电流环+速度环）——为什么电流环在里面（内环）、速度环在外面（外环）？内外环的响应速度谁快谁慢？

  2. 交流异步电机的矢量控制（Vector Control / FOC）核心思想是什么？"解耦"在控制里是什么意思——为什么要把定子电流分解成励磁分量和转矩分量？

▎ 新能源与智能电网

  1. 光伏发电的 I-V 特性曲线——为什么光照和温度变化时最大功率点在移动？MPPT（最大功率点跟踪）是怎么找到这个点的？

▎ 供配电技术

  1. 工厂供电里的"一级负荷"、"二级负荷"、"三级负荷"是按什么划分的？一栋医院大楼和一栋普通写字楼，配电方案的根本区别在哪？

  2. 变配电所的"主接线方式"——单母线分段和双母线两种接线的可靠性差在哪？一路进线检修时，两种接线分别能保住多少负荷？

▎ 电磁兼容（EMC）

  1. 电磁兼容的三个要素（干扰源、耦合路径、敏感设备）——传导发射和辐射发射的区别是什么？一个开关电源的开关频率谐波走的是传导还是辐射路径？

  2. 为什么 PCB 上的"地弹"（ground bounce）会导致数字电路误触发？一个高频信号的回流路径如果面积很大，辐射出去的能量是怎么变大的？

▎ 电气安全与接地

  1. TN、TT、IT 三种接地系统的区别是什么？为什么工厂里最常见的是 TN-S（三相五线制）？如果设备外壳没接地，人碰到会承受多大电压？

  2. 人身安全电流的阈值大概是多少？"30mA 是安全上限"这个说法是怎么来的——为什么漏电保护开关的动作电流通常选 30mA？

▎ 变频器技术

  1. 变频器（VFD）的主电路——整流桥、直流母线、逆变器——三段各在做什么？为什么变频器的直流母线电容经常是瓶颈（寿命短、容易鼓包）？

  2. V/f 控制（恒压频比）和矢量控制（FOC）在低频段的表现有什么本质差别？为什么开环 V/f 在低速时转矩不足？

▎ 过程控制与 DCS

  1. 回路控制（feedback loop）里，4-20mA 电流环为什么是工业现场信号传输的标准？4mA 对应量程下限而 0mA 表示断线——这个设计解决了什么问题？

  2. DCS（分散控制系统）和 PLC 的本质区别是什么？一个用在化工连续过程，一个用在单机设备控制——如果把 PLC 用在大型化工装置上，会出什么问题？

▎ 电能质量与谐波治理

  1. 什么是"谐波"？一个带整流器的变频器往电网里注入的谐波以哪几次为主——为什么是 5 次、7 次、11 次这些"特征谐波"？

  2. 有源滤波器（APF）和无源滤波器在治理谐波上各自的原理是什么？为什么 APF 越来越普及但仍有人用无源方案？

▎ 电气测量技术

  1. 电压互感器（PT）和电流互感器（CT）为什么二次侧不能开路/短路？——CT 在运行中断开二次侧会发生什么？

  2. 电力系统里测量电能用的"电能表"是怎么计量有功和无功电能的？传统的感应式电能表和现在的智能电能表在原理上有什么不同？

▎ 控制电机（特种电机）

▎ 电化学储能系统安全

  1. 锂电池储能电站的"热失控"是怎么发生的？电池内部短路 → 温度升高 → 隔膜收缩 → 更大的短路面积 → 更高的温度 → 电解液分解产气 → 电池鼓包→起火/爆炸。这个正反馈链条中，BMS（电池管理系统）在哪个节点有可能会打断它——是通过监测每颗电芯的温度和电压，达到阈值就切断充放电？

  2. 为什么储能电站经常发生"先着火后冒烟"的现象？磷酸铁锂电池（LFP）热失控后的起火模式跟三元锂有什么不同？LFP 虽然热稳定性好，但热失控后会释放大量可燃气体（CO、H₂、CH₄），积聚到爆炸下限后遇到火花就会爆燃。储能电站的消防安全措施是怎么针对这个特点设计的——防爆通风 + 可燃气体探测 + 水喷雾降温？

▎ 电动汽车 V2G 与充放电技术

  1. V2G（Vehicle-to-Grid）的核心是什么——电动汽车的电池不只能充电，还能在电网需要时反向放电。一个 60kWh 的私家车，平时通勤只用了 10kWh，剩余的 50kWh 容量可以在晚高峰以 7kW 的功率放电约 7 小时——给电网提供调峰服务的同时赚取电费差价。但问题是，频繁充放电会加速电池衰减——V2G 每天放一次电，一年后电池容量会衰减多少，车主能接受的衰减阈值是多少？

  2. 充电桩的 AC（交流慢充）和 DC（直流快充）在充电拓扑上有什么本质区别？交流桩只是把电网的交流电通过车上的车载充电机整流后充进电池（功率 3-7kW），直流桩直接把交流整流成直流送进电池（功率 50-350kW）。350kW 的超充桩要在 15 分钟内充 80%——直流端的电流高达 500A 以上，充电枪的液冷散热是怎么做的？

▎ 电力系统碳核算与碳追踪

  1. 电力系统的碳排放核算是怎么算的？一个工厂每用 1000kWh 电，碳排放量 = 1000 × 电网平均排放因子。但电网在不同时间段的碳排放强度不同（光伏多的时候低、火电顶峰的时候高）——如果想精确计算用户在某时段的用电碳排放，需要比"平均因子"更精细的"动态碳排放因子"。这个动态因子怎么计算——基于每个时间断面各机组的出力数据？

  2. 绿电交易（绿色电力证书 / Green Certificate）是怎么运作的？一个企业想宣称自己使用了 100% 可再生能源——它购买了绿证（1 个绿证 = 1000kWh 可再生能源电量），但这个证书背后对应的是某个风电场的名义发电量，跟实际流进企业工厂的电力是同一股电流吗？绿证机制解决的是"环境权益"的权属问题，不是物理电力的流向问题——能理解这个区别吗？

▎ 综合能源系统

  1. 综合能源系统（Integrated Energy System）把电力系统、热力系统、天然气系统耦合在一起——一台燃气轮机同时发电和供热（热电联产），产生的电送电网、热送热网。这个耦合给电力系统提供了什么额外灵活性？当电网需要快速增发时，热电联产机组的"热-电解耦"是怎么做到的——靠储热罐？

  2. 电转气（Power-to-Gas, P2G）是什么——当可再生能源过剩时，用电制氢（电解水），氢气可以直接使用、或注入天然气管网、或进一步合成甲烷。但这个来回转换的效率很低——电→氢约 70-80%，氢→电约 40-50%，总效率只有 30-40%。为什么这么低的效率还有人研究 P2G？因为在几百 GWh 的季节性能源储存场景下，电池已经不可行了（按 TWh 级的容量算，锂电池的成本和原材料都无法承受）？

docs.title: 嵌入式 1000 问｜Flomo 原始总表迁移
docs.text:
本页保留原始导航与问题地图。建议后续按专题拆页，并从这里维护入口。

原始来源： https://v.flomoapp.com/mine/?memo_id=MjQ1NzMzNDk3 创建时间： 2026-07-08T06:54:11+08:00 最近更新： 2026-10-06T21:03:25+08:00 原文长度： 16829 字

专栏⑮·导航：嵌入式 1000 问全景——从裸机到驱动的完整地图

📎 专栏⑭C语言导航 → https://v.flomoapp.com/mine/?memo_id=MjQ1NzM0NTk5

📎 专栏⑬硬件导航 → https://v.flomoapp.com/mine/?memo_id=MjQ3NTQ2MDE3

▎目录（10篇）

  1. 上电到 main()——启动文件、向量表、栈指针，Bootloader 跳 APP 的三个坑

  2. 时钟配置——HSE→PLL→SYSCLK，顺序乱了 MCU 就 hang

  3. PWM 与定时器——ARR/PSC/CCR 的关系，一个公式算清频率和占空比

  4. 链接脚本——内存地图、段分配、LMA/VMA，5 个最常见的 .ld 错误

  5. 单片机学习路径——4 阶段：裸机筑基→寄存器级外设→综合项目→RTOS

  6. 基础概念与架构——嵌入式 vs 通用计算机、MCU vs MPU、冯诺依曼 vs 哈佛

  7. 中断与 ISR——中断延迟、嵌套、临界区，ISR 为什么越短越好

  8. 嵌入式 Linux 驱动入门——字符设备、设备树、file_operations、下半部

  9. 嵌入式调试三板斧——HardFault 定位、printf 的坑、示波器 vs 逻辑分析仪

  10. 嵌入式 15 项自检清单——上车前逐项打勾

▎补充篇（4篇）

  1. 补充一：RTOS 内核——从裸机 super-loop 到任务调度 → https://v.flomoapp.com/mine/?memo_id=MjUxMjA1MDcx

  2. 补充二：DMA——数据搬运不占 CPU 的隐形引擎 → https://v.flomoapp.com/mine/?memo_id=MjUxMjA1MDkw

  3. 补充三：低功耗设计——睡眠、唤醒、功耗测量 → https://v.flomoapp.com/mine/?memo_id=MjUxMjA1MTEy

  4. 补充四：看门狗与可靠性——喂狗策略决定系统能不能自己活过来 → https://v.flomoapp.com/mine/?memo_id=MjUxMjA1MTM5

▎设计原则

  • 每条问题从"软件工程师真实踩坑"出发，不写教科书复述

  • 90+ 方向的问题库作为全景索引，每篇深挖一个方向的实战

  • 与 AUTOSAR（专栏①-⑩）、C语言（⑭）、硬件（⑬）互链，嵌入式是承上启下的主线

▎1000 问全景（问题库）

基础概念

  1. 嵌入式系统和通用计算机系统最本质的区别是什么？这个区别决定了哪些设计上的不同？

  2. MCU和MPU的核心区别是什么？什么时候该选MCU，什么时候该选MPU？

  3. 冯诺依曼结构和哈佛结构在嵌入式系统里怎么体现？STM32是哪一种？

  4. 为什么嵌入式软件经常要跟"寄存器"打交道？读写寄存器和读写普通内存有什么不同？

处理器与架构

  1. Cortex-M3的"三级流水线"是哪三级？它和Cortex-A系列的处理器的流水线有什么不同？

  2. 什么是"向量表"？中断来了以后CPU怎么从向量表找到对应的处理函数？

  3. ARM的Thumb指令集和Thumb-2是什么？为什么嵌入式里经常用Thumb而不是ARM指令集？

  4. RISC-V和ARM在架构设计哲学上有什么关键区别？为什么RISC-V近年发展这么快？

  5. 大端和小端（Big-endian / Little-endian）在嵌入式开发中什么时候会出问题？

存储器与链接

  1. 嵌入式系统的存储层级（SRAM、Flash、SDRAM、EEPROM）各有什么特点？代码放哪、数据放哪？

  2. 链接脚本（Linker Script）在做什么？为什么嵌入式开发要自己写.ld文件？

  3. 堆和栈在嵌入式系统里分别在哪？栈溢出了一般会发生什么？怎么预防？

  4. MMU和MPU有什么区别？什么场景下嵌入式系统需要MMU？

GPIO与外设

  1. GPIO的推挽输出和开漏输出有什么区别？什么场景下必须用开漏？

  2. 为什么UART要设波特率？收发双方的波特率差多少会出错？

  3. I2C为什么需要上拉电阻？它的"开漏"设计跟UART的推挽设计各自解决了什么问题？

  4. SPI和I2C在什么场景下选哪个？为什么说SPI比I2C快？

  5. ADC的采样率、分辨率和精度之间是什么关系？一个12位的ADC是不是一定比10位的"准"？

中断与异常

  1. 中断和异常的区别是什么？按中断向量表和异常向量表来区分的话，它们各自的入口在哪？

  2. 中断服务函数（ISR）为什么越短越好？如果必须做耗时操作，有哪些处理方式？

  3. 中断嵌套会发生什么？什么时候应该允许中断嵌套，什么时候应该禁止？

  4. 中断优先级和子优先级（如STM32的NVIC分组）——为什么要分成两组？怎么配置？

  5. 临界区（critical section）是什么？为什么在ISR里和任务里保护临界区的方式不一样？

定时器

  1. 定时器的本质是什么？一个定时器"溢出"时发生了什么？

  2. 通用定时器和高级定时器（如STM32的TIM和TIM1/8）在哪些功能上有差别？什么场景必须用高级定时器？

  3. PWM是怎么通过定时器产生的？占空比和频率各由什么寄存器控制？

  4. 输入捕获和输出比较——一个是读、一个是写，各自的典型应用场景是什么？

  5. 看门狗定时器（WDT）为什么叫"看门狗"？如果程序跑飞了，它是怎么"咬"的？

DMA

  1. DMA为什么能"不经过CPU"传输数据？那CPU在DMA工作期间在干什么？

  2. 什么时候该用DMA，什么时候直接CPU轮询或中断更合适？

  3. DMA的循环模式（circular mode）和普通模式有什么区别——什么时候需要循环？

  4. DMA传输完成的中断比普通外设中断在实时性上有什么不同？

低功耗

  1. 嵌入式系统的三种功耗模式（Sleep/Stop/Standby）分别在关什么？从Stop唤醒比从Standby快的原因是什么？

  2. 什么时候应该进入低功耗模式？频繁进出低功耗反而更耗电——这个阈值怎么判断？

  3. 低功耗设计不只是软件的事——外围电路（如GPIO上拉电阻、供电LDO的选择）在低功耗里起了什么作用？

RTOS（实时操作系统）

  1. FreeRTOS的任务调度是靠什么机制切换任务的？为什么叫"抢占式调度"？

  2. 任务状态机（就绪、运行、阻塞、挂起）——一个任务在这四个状态之间是怎么跳转的？

  3. 信号量（Semaphore）和互斥量（Mutex）的区别是什么？什么场景下用错会出问题？

  4. 消息队列和邮箱的本质区别是什么？如果要在多个任务之间传一组结构化数据，选哪个？

  5. 什么是优先级反转？FreeRTOS怎么处理这个问题？

  6. FreeRTOS的Tickless模式是干什么的？它和低功耗模式怎么配合？

Bootloader

  1. Bootloader的作用是什么？为什么嵌入式系统要有Bootloader而不是直接跑应用程序？

  2. 常见的"二级Bootloader"是怎么启动的？从ROM Boot→Bootloader→Application的跳转过程是怎样的？

  3. Bootloader做固件更新时，怎么保证更新中途掉电了还能恢复？

  4. Bootloader怎么用CRC或校验和来验证固件的完整性？如果校验失败怎么办？

  5. Bootloader和应用代码在Flash里怎么分区？两个区域的地址边界谁来定？

嵌入式Linux / 驱动

  1. Linux内核驱动的"字符设备"和"平台设备"有什么区别？什么时候该写哪一类？

  2. 设备树（Device Tree）是干什么的？以前没有设备树的时候怎么描述硬件？

  3. GPIO驱动程序里，request、direction_output、direction_input这几个操作各对应硬件上的什么动作？

  4. 中断下半部（Bottom Half）为什么需要？Tasklet、Workqueue、Threaded IRQ各自适合什么场景？

  5. 用户空间的open/read/write系统调用是怎么一步步到达硬件寄存器的？驱动模型里的file_operations结构体是干什么的？

调试与工具

  1. JTAG和SWD有什么区别？为什么STM32上SWD只用了两根线？

  2. printf调试和断点调试各自的优缺点——在实时嵌入式系统里，为什么printf本身可能改变问题的表现？

  3. 逻辑分析仪和示波器在嵌入式调试中各自看什么？什么场景下选逻辑分析仪，什么场景选示波器？

  4. 当程序跑飞了（HardFault）——一般第一步做什么来确定是哪里出了问题？

通信协议深入

  1. CAN总线为什么需要120Ω终端电阻？如果没接或少接一个，实际通信中会出现什么现象？

  2. CAN FD和Classic CAN在帧格式上有什么关键区别？为什么CAN FD能传更多数据还更快？

  3. LIN总线为什么是"低成本CAN"的定位？它的主从架构跟CAN的多主架构比，各适合什么场景？

  4. SPI的片选（CS）信号在多个从设备时怎么管理？如果片选信号抖动了一下，会发生什么？

RTOS深入实战

  1. 死锁（deadlock）在嵌入式RTOS里是怎么发生的？两个任务互相等对方释放资源的场景——实际遇到过吗？

  2. 任务优先级怎么定才合理？如果所有任务都是同一个优先级，调度器会怎么处理？

  3. 一个任务里调用了delay或vTaskDelay——这段时间里调度器在做什么？CPU在"空转"还是跑了别的任务？

  4. RTOS的栈（task stack）和裸机的栈有什么不同？为什么任务栈溢出比裸机栈溢出更难排查？

性能分析与代码优化

  1. 怎么确定一个嵌入式系统CPU的负载率（utilization）？是算出来的还是测出来的？

  2. 代码放在Flash里跑和放在RAM里跑，速度差多少？什么情况下你会把关键代码放到RAM里执行？

  3. 为什么C语言里用全局变量有时候比函数传参快？这个"快"的代价是什么？

硬件-软件边界

  1. 去耦电容（decoupling capacitor）是硬件的事还是软件也该懂？如果去耦不充分，软件上可能看到什么症状？

  2. GPIO输出电流不够驱动外部继电器或LED时——软件能做什么？不能做什么？

  3. 电平转换（3.3V↔5V）在I2C和UART上做法有什么不同？配置错了软件上会看到什么现象？

  4. 为什么有时候用示波器看一个信号是对的，但软件读到的值是错的？同步问题还是电平问题？

传感器与执行器

  1. I2C传感器的"地址"是怎么来的？如果总线上两个传感器地址冲突了，软件能做什么、硬件能做什么？

  2. 模拟信号传感器（如NTC热敏电阻、电位器）和数字信号传感器（如I2C温湿度计）在集成时的设计难点分别是什么？

  3. 为什么有些传感器需要"上电等待时间"（power-up time）？如果上电后立刻读数据，会读到什么？

  4. 用继电器和用MOSFET做开关控制负载，各自适合什么场景？

电机控制基础

  1. 直流有刷电机用H桥控制正反转和速度——H桥四个开关管的状态表是什么样的？为什么不能同时打开同一侧的两个开关？

  2. 为什么无刷直流电机（BLDC）需要"换向"？霍尔传感器在BLDC里起了什么作用？

  3. 步进电机的"步距角"是什么意思？为什么步进电机可以精确定位但直流电机不行？

安全性与可靠性

  1. 为什么Flash和RAM需要ECC（纠错码）？ECC能纠正多少位错误？发现无法纠正的错误时应该怎么办？

  2. 冗余设计的两种方式——"双机热备"和"三模冗余"——各自在什么成本层级上适用？

  3. 内建自测试（BIST）在嵌入式系统里通常测什么？上电自检跑多久才算合理？

固件升级深入

  1. 安全固件升级为什么需要"签名校验"？签名和CRC校验在安全性上的本质区别是什么？

  2. A/B分区升级（dual bank OTA）是怎么实现"升级失败还能回滚"的？两个区怎么切换？

  3. 如果OTA下载过程中通信断了，已经下载到一半的数据怎么处理？下次是续传还是重头来？

实时性分析

  1. 什么是"最差执行时间"（WCET）？理论和实际之间为什么总有一个差值？

  2. 从GPIO中断触发到ISR第一条代码开始执行——这中间的延迟（interrupt latency）包含了哪些环节？

QEMU 与仿真调试

  1. QEMU 的 system mode 和 user mode 在嵌入式开发里各自有什么用？在 QEMU 上跑 ARM 裸机代码和跑 Linux 内核，各要用什么命令启动？

  2. 用 QEMU 仿真 STM32（如 qemu-system-arm -M stm32vldiscovery）能仿真到什么程度？GPIO 电平变化能不能看到？UART 输出能不能重定向到终端？

非易失性存储管理与文件系统

  1. 为什么在 Flash 上跑文件系统（如 LittleFS、SPIFFS）需要"磨损均衡"和"掉电安全"？一个拔电测试频繁的 IoT 设备，如果文件系统不防掉电，最可能出什么故障？

  2. MCU 内部 Flash 模拟 EEPROM（Emulated EEPROM）是怎么实现的？为什么 NXP 和 ST 都有各自的"EEPROM 模拟"方案——直接把数据按固定地址写不行吗？

Zephyr RTOS

  1. Zephyr 和 FreeRTOS 在架构上最大的不同是什么？为什么 Zephyr 用"设备树（devicetree）"来描述硬件平台，而 FreeRTOS 靠手动改头文件？

  2. Zephyr 的线程（thread）、信号量（semaphore）、消息队列（message queue）概念和 FreeRTOS 一一对应吗？如果一个 FreeRTOS 老手转用 Zephyr，最容易在哪踩坑？

FlexRay 协议

  1. FlexRay 的"静态段"和"动态段"各在传输什么类型的消息？为什么 FlexRay 被设计为"确定性"总线——和 CAN 的"事件触发"比，在时间确定性上有什么本质不同？

  2. FlexRay 为什么在航空和高级汽车底盘控制（如线控制动）里仍然在用？既然 CAN FD 的速度上来了，FlexRay 还有什么不可替代的优势？

裸机调度器设计

  1. 不用 RTOS 时，怎么在裸机上实现"多任务"效果？一个简单的前后台系统（超级循环 + 定时器中断标志）和协作式任务调度器（cooperative scheduler）——差别在哪？

  2. 裸机调度器的"任务控制块"（TCB）最小需要存什么？如果在 Cortex-M 上用协程（protothreads / coroutine）模拟多个执行流，切换时怎么保存和恢复上下文？

嵌入式图形（LVGL）

  1. LVGL（LittlevGL）在 STM32 上跑时，最消耗 RAM 的是哪个部分？一个 480×320 分辨率、16位色深的显示缓冲区是怎么分配的——单缓冲、双缓冲还是局部刷新？

  2. LVGL 的 tick（心跳）和显示刷新是两回事——为什么需要一个定时器产生 LVGL 的 tick 才能保证 UI 响应，而显示驱动通过 flush_callback 刷新？如果 tick 停了但 flush 还在跑，UI 会怎么样？

实时 Linux（PREEMPT_RT）

  1. 标准 Linux 内核的"最差中断延迟"对于实时应用来说为什么太大？PREEMPT_RT 补丁通过把 spinlock 变成可抢占的 rt_mutex 来降低延迟——它在原理上做了什么？

  2. PREEMPT_RT 能保证微秒级确定性吗？一个跑着 PREEMPT_RT 的 Raspberry Pi 和一个裸机 MCU 相比，在 IO 响应时间上谁更可控？

物联网协议（MQTT / CoAP）

  1. MQTT 的发布-订阅模型和传统客户端-服务器模型的本质区别是什么？一个传感器节点（发布端）和一个手机 App（订阅端）之间——MQTT Broker 起了什么作用？

  2. CoAP 和 MQTT 都用于 IoT，但一个跑在 UDP 上、一个跑在 TCP 上——这个差异决定了它们各适合什么场景？一个电池供电的温湿度传感器，应该用 CoAP 还是 MQTT？

数字信号处理基础（IIR / FIR）

  1. FIR 滤波器和 IIR 滤波器的核心区别是什么？为什么在嵌入式系统里 FIR 更稳定（始终有线性相位），但 IIR 用更少的阶数就能达到同样的截止效果？

  2. 在 MCU 上实现一个 FIR 滤波器，最耗时的操作是乘累加（MAC）。如果用 Cortex-M4 的 DSP 指令（SMUAD）和普通 C 写 for 循环算同一个 FIR——性能差多少？CMSIS-DSP 做了这个优化吗？

代码覆盖率分析

  1. 嵌入式测试里的语句覆盖、分支覆盖、MC/DC 覆盖有什么区别？为什么航空级（DO-178C）要求 MC/DC 覆盖，而一般工业项目只做到分支覆盖就够了？

  2. 在嵌入式 C 项目里，gcov 和 lcov 怎么用？一个跑在 QEMU 或实际板子上的测试程序，怎么把覆盖率数据从目标板导出来生成报告？

TFLite Micro 与模型量化

  1. TFLite Micro 把一个训练好的 TensorFlow 模型部署到 Cortex-M 上——第一步是"量化"：从 float32 变成 int8。模型精度会损失多少？为什么量化后推理速度能快 3-4 倍？

  2. 一个音频关键词识别模型（如 "Hey Google" 检测）部署到 Cortex-M4 上，推理一次大概要多少内存和多少毫秒？什么因素决定能不能塞进一个 256KB Flash 的 MCU？

MCU 选型与架构对比

  1. STM32F4（Cortex-M4）、S32K3（Cortex-M7）、TC3xx（TriCore）、RH850（G3KH）——四个架构的 MCU 各有什么不可替代的优势？为什么汽车动力域 ECU 选了英飞凌 TriCore 而不是 ARM Cortex？

docs.title: 启动流程与故障隔离
docs.text: • 嵌入式启动流程与故障隔离指南：从复位向量、启动文件、链接布局到 main、OS、ISR 与通信故障的分层排查。

docs.title: 嵌入式启动流程与故障隔离指南
docs.text: 用途：从复位入口开始，按可验证的证据定位“未进 main、启动后异常复位、任务不运行、通信失效”等问题。具体寄存器、启动文件与异常机制以 MCU 内核、芯片手册和项目链接配置为准。

docs.title: 1. 启动链路总览
docs.text:
flowchart TD
    A[复位源与复位向量] --> B[启动汇编 / 向量表]
    B --> C[设置栈指针与运行环境]
    C --> D[初始化 .data / .bss]
    D --> E[时钟与芯片基础初始化]
    E --> F[C/C++ 运行库初始化]
    F --> G[main / OS 启动入口]
    G --> H[驱动与中间件初始化]
    H --> I[任务 / 中断 / 通信运行]
    A -. 异常复位 .-> J[复位原因寄存器与复位计数]
    J --> K[记录证据并缩小故障范围]

此图是通用流程，不意味着所有 MCU 的初始化顺序完全一致；部分平台会在进入 C 运行库前初始化时钟，部分项目由 Bootloader 转交控制权。

docs.title: 2. 按症状分层排查
docs.text: 症状 优先检查 证据 未进入 main 复位向量、启动文件、链接地址、栈指针、镜像入口 PC/LR、向量表内容、Map 文件、调试器反汇编 进入 main 后异常 .data/.bss 初始化、时钟、外设早期访问、全局对象初始化 断点、内存窗口、时钟状态、异常寄存器 周期任务不执行 OS 启动、计数器/Alarm/ScheduleTable、任务激活与优先级 OS 状态、任务栈、调度跟踪、计数器配置 中断不触发 向量表、使能位、优先级、清除挂起标志、屏蔽状态 NVIC/INTC 状态、ISR 断点、寄存器快照 通信失效 时钟/波特率、收发器状态、过滤器、DMA/中断、协议路由 示波器/逻辑分析仪、总线日志、驱动回调计数 重启循环 复位原因、看门狗、异常处理、启动阶段进度标记 Reset Cause、复位计数、HardFault/异常现场、日志 数据重启后丢失 RAM 镜像与 NV 存储的区别、写入请求和作业完成状态 NvM 状态、底层存储错误、掉电时序、重启后数据

docs.title: 3. 最小化故障隔离流程
docs.text:
1. 先确认复位类型：读取并保存芯片复位原因寄存器，注意有些寄存器需尽早读取或显式清除。
  2. 建立启动阶段标记：在复位入口、C 运行库后、main、驱动初始化完成、OS 启动后分别设置可观测标记；避免仅依赖可能尚未初始化的 printf。
  3. 核对镜像与链接布局：检查 ELF/Map 文件中的入口地址、向量表、代码段、数据段、栈/堆边界及 Bootloader/APP 地址约定。
  4. 检查时钟与内存：确认 PLL/时钟切换成功，RAM 可读写，缓存/MPU/MMU 配置符合平台要求。
  5. 检查中断和调度：确认全局中断、单个中断源、OS 启动状态、任务激活、优先级与栈水位。
  6. 沿接口逐层追踪：通信链路从物理层/驱动回调逐步追到协议栈和应用，不要直接把“应用没收到”认定为应用解析错误。
  7. 固定复现条件：记录软件版本、配置基线、供电、温度、触发顺序和复位原因；每次只改变一个变量。
  8. 保留失败现场：异常 PC/LR、堆栈、关键寄存器、任务状态和最近阶段标记应尽可能在重启前持久化或通过调试器捕获。

docs.title: 4. 关键工程注意事项
docs.text:
• 启动代码、链接脚本、编译器选项和芯片启动模式必须作为同一工程基线检查。
  • 不要假设所有 RAM 在 C 运行库初始化前都可用；早期日志应使用平台允许的方式。
  • ISR 内尽量保持短小，避免阻塞调用、不可控循环或不安全的共享数据访问。
  • 看门狗复位可能是结果而不是根因；必须区分任务未运行、喂狗条件错误、异常死循环和真正的硬件故障。
  • 在 AUTOSAR 项目中，将 EcuM/BswM/OS 初始化顺序、SchM/ISR 配置、生成代码与 ARXML 配置纳入同一条证据链。

docs.title: 5. 验收清单
docs.text:
• 能确认每次异常的复位来源。
  • 能证明启动流程最后成功到达的阶段。
  • Map 文件与实际烧录地址一致。
  • 任务、ISR 与时钟状态可被观测。
  • 故障复现条件和修复前后证据可追溯。
  • 修复后覆盖冷启动、热复位、看门狗复位及相关异常路径。
